AC-01.title: Complete bodies and exact output identity
AC-01.text:
**Affected: all 167. KEEP the complete-body principle; NEW advanced body bindings below.** Each successful output transforms one separately reserved complete mundane body, not a fraction of a reusable source tool or an intact duplicate of a consumed core. Reserve `floor(1.5Q)` eligible bodies before work, where Q is original Standard quantity. A body is one whole selected model, not one charge, page, participant, automaton encounter or programmed task. Fixed models and actual alternate EN weapon/armor parent records must be chosen before work; one model/size per batch. The register lists every family and recipe membership.

One physical primary member cannot belong to two reserves, a retained working toolkit and an output, or two simultaneous orders. Printed inputs remain additional process requirements. Bodies carry their own actual mass, custody, grade and structural history. Consumed process matter becomes incorporated treatment or tracked process waste; its full mass is not copied into every output and it has no automatic second recipe/sale entitlement. Output bodies have the bound empty mass; actual separate contents remain additional mass. No undocumented finished ingredient or intact consumed catalyst is also present inside the result.
AC-01.verdictHeading: ## AC-01 — Complete bodies and exact output identity

AC-02.title: Reservation, current damage and replacement
AC-02.text:
**Affected: all 167. KEEP ordered-reserve/current-state rules.** All maximum reserves must be complete, functional, uncommitted elsewhere and present immediately before the single completion roll, even if Standard would use fewer. Missing, Broken, incomplete or conflicting reserves pause work before the roll. Lawful repair or replacement keeps the original ordered position and records the replacement's own history. No purchase, substitution, reordering or selection after the roll.

Transform the first N entries for resolved yield, or first Q for an allowed structural option. Unused bodies remain their actual ordinary stock. Failed/Mishap transforms none; independently surviving bodies remain mundane except for actual mishap damage. Their return is not 25% ingredient recovery. The lead and station must have the actual capacity to work sequentially on the bodies; reserved stock may require separate storage rather than fitting simultaneously on a bench.

Ordinary EN weapon/armor bodies may retain a genuinely established mundane equipment grade, size and physical workmanship history, as in Blacksmithing. The newly specified fixed nonweapon bodies are Standard grade; a name such as Masterwork is not a grade. All reserves must be never-magically-altered; no spent or suppressed imprint qualifies as a blank. **NEW creature-chassis restriction:** the 18 automaton recipes and 686 use complete, unmodified, unflawed B5 mundane chassis, Tiny or Small as allowed; no prior creature or class device can be their blank.
AC-02.verdictHeading: ## AC-02 — Reservation, current damage and replacement

AC-03.title: Six manufacturing bands; structural versus creature quality
AC-03.text:
**Affected: all 167; explicit creature exception applies to the 18 automata in TI-03 and recipe-686.** KEEP six-band creation, natural-1 Mishap, and no natural-20 band shift. Standard Q; Exceptional yield `floor(1.25Q)`; Masterwork yield `floor(1.5Q)`. Eligible Forge Dwarf changes Standard to Exceptional for the existing output choice, not to Masterwork. One genuine Masterwork catalyst retention is independent of that choice.

For an actual structural object, the alternative keeps Q and attaches at most P25 or P50 to its actual ordinary B after lawful size/grade rules. Retain only the strongest lawful workmanship percentage. Improved maximum is `B + max(1,floor(B×P/100))` when P>0, otherwise B. Apply one persistent singleton flaw last: `max(1,floor(improvedMax/2))`. Validate old maximum from its history and retain `oldMax-oldCurrent` damage deficit; new current is the new maximum minus that deficit, clamped to [0,newMax]. Standard neither heals nor removes modifiers. At B5 maxima are 5/6/7 or flawed 2/3/3; at B1 they are 1/2/2 or flawed 1/1/1. EN armor uses its real B, not B5.

Q≥2 Flawed makes `floor(Q/2)` normal-effect units retaining actual old flaws; an output count of one does not impose a new singleton flaw. Q1 structural Flawed gives one persistently flawed result, possibly Broken after retained damage. No additional duration penalty is invented for these durable carriers. Expended Rune/script uses do not make their surviving body a disposable potion.

**NEW explicit creature-output decision:** source AC/HP for the 18 automata and 686 are creature statistics, not structural B. No structural option changes their HP, AC, Speed, attacks, service count or command capacity. The alternative simply retains Q with the quality label and no mechanical improvement; do not pretend an improvement occurred. A Q1 Flawed result maps to Failed under the unsupported-flaw fallback. Q≥2 Flawed retains the ordinary reduced-yield rule. For a produced creature, initial HP is `max(1,floor(sourceHP × latestChassisCurrent/5))`; full chassis produces full source HP, damaged chassis stays proportionally damaged. This is an explicit creation conversion, not healing or class-companion scaling. Later healing uses the printed source maximum.

No quality choice increases charges, spell rank, attacks, damage, DCs, preparation scope, contract participants, storage, command targets, sunrise refills or creature HP. No later upgrade/reimprint/flaw-removal procedure is granted by a formula capable of calculating those numbers.
AC-03.verdictHeading: ## AC-03 — Six manufacturing bands; structural versus creature quality

AC-04.title: All inputs, catalysts, precision and waste
AC-04.text:
**Affected: all 758 occurrences. KEEP exact roles and flags.** Counts are EN199 (12 nonconsumed tools,187 consumed,80 catalysts); RC188 (17/171/41); SC177 (28/149/42); TI194 (33/161/9). Total **90 nonconsumed tools,668 consumed rows,172 catalysts and six consumed-tool rows**. These are occurrences, not sums of their quantities. Duplicate catalog IDs still need distinct physical quantities.

The six consumed tools are **637[1],639[3],673[3],685[2],686[2],687[4]**. They remain consumed, including 7,500-gp and18,000-gp EN lenses, the200-gp Scribing case,200-gp/18,000-gp control mechanisms and18,000-gp connecting rods. None can simultaneously be the retained toolkit or supplemental complete body. Each eligible Masterwork returns **one actual unit total** from a consumed role=catalyst occurrence recorded for that recipe, selected after the check. The register lists all172 occurrences. High price, a core/essence name, wholeCreatureUse or rareCatalystRequired metadata never changes the role. A recoverable catalyst must participate nondestructively until retention is decided; do not destroy it early and invent a replacement. No additional supplied destruction clause overrides this bounded exception.

Failed creation recovers25% per exact consumed non-catalyst identity, capped by actual remaining material, rounded down to its legal unit. **NEW explicit bulk precision:** EN Veilthread; RC Runic ink and Binding agent; SC Ink and Preservation treatment use0.01 of their exact source unit, when actually supplied in the stated divisible thread/liquid/bulk form. All other listed prepared stones, crystals/lenses, matrices, glyph pieces, parchment/cover/binding units, hardware packs, cells and consumed tools are indivisible source units unless their own actual independent source profile specifies subdivision. No quarter-lens, quarter-bolt or quarter-core is invented. The new service supplies in TI-06 have their own definition, not a rewritten recipe ingredient.

Mishap/abandonment returns no consumed inputs. Actual nonconsumed tools survive unless a real event damages/loses them. Returned fractions and catalysts preserve age, condition and actual vessels. No Failed work-in-progress/waste gets another default salvage pass. Prior Mining/Skinning/Salvaging finite-matter histories remain controlling.
AC-04.verdictHeading: ## AC-04 — All inputs, catalysts, precision and waste

AC-05.title: Four artisan creation credentials, stationary work and hours
AC-05.text:
**Affected: all 167. KEEP current trade gates; do not import gathering's non-artisan exclusion.** All four creations use **INT** and their actual primary artisan credential: Enchanter's tools; Runecarver's tools; Calligrapher's supplies; Tinker's tools. One applicable PB/expertise contribution, not numerical trade level. Untrained otherwise eligible recipes1–4 use no tool PB and disadvantage; trained eligibility is `max(4,trade level)` and actual formula/source access. Above4 still needs the required formula. Every actual discovery field and capped trivial threshold is preserved.

Stations and auxiliary implements remain the exact source requirements: Resonance Circle/lens/stylus; Runecarver's Slab/stylus/current lens-or-crystal wording under RC-09; Scribe's Desk/quill/straightedge; Tinker's Workshop/drivers/calibration gauge. An inclusive kit may provide its actual ordinary implements, not another expensive tiered occurrence or an absent station. Source facilities give no automatic bonus. Rent uses the existing1gp/eight reserved hours baseline only at a genuinely available compatible facility, not an invented building or unlimited capacity.

**All167 fieldCraftable flags are false.** A historical timeMode=field limits active time; it does not permit improvised field creation against that flag. Use an actual suitable fixed facility at a lawful worksite; expedition mode still needs its reviewed fortified/research-site permission and fixed required facility. Workshop, haven, legacy and special long-term access retain their distinctions. Required assistants meet their source eligibility/cap and work all required hours; they do not shorten the order or earn assistant crafting XP.

Eligible **Forge Dwarf** creation uses ×0.75 active hours, rounded upward once to a whole minute, plus its Standard-to-Exceptional rule. It does not waive bodies/formulas/credentials/stations or reduce servicing, repair, research, encoding, attunement, calendar waits or actual rest. Recipe623 is specifically completed in TI-10. All other active hours remain literal. Two-active-work-Watch limits, rest restrictions and no overlapping labor remain.

**NEW advanced stable phase:** first `min(15 minutes, adjusted total active time)` is included in the order, followed by preregistered phases of at most8 active hours. Only actual eligible incorporated inputs stabilize at completed phases. Raw stock and recoverable catalysts retain their own clocks/protection; stabilization is not portable raw-material stasis. An interruption loses unfinished creation-phase progress only, not real costs, history or completed phases. Actual damaged/ineligible inputs pause the order. No item powers operate during unfinished crafting.

Keep the framework's actual first-success/repeat/qualified-failure/triviality XP, formula research and ordinary formula copying. Source skillXPOnSuccess is not an extra award on activation, servicing, repair, study or a class-produced tool.
AC-05.verdictHeading: ## AC-05 — Four artisan creation credentials, stationary work and hours

AC-06.title: State, budgets, suppression and chronology
AC-06.text:
**Affected: all167. KEEP identity, custody and actual-state rules; NEW budget bindings are trade-specific below.** Initialize each produced object's stated budget once at lawful completion, even if a structural Flawed result is Broken. Repair may expose an existing budget but never create another initialization. Separate physical outputs have separate budgets; no pooled or transferable charges. A copy or snapshot is not another usable item.

Magic requires complete positive-HP, accessible, unmelded, unsuppressed actual participating equipment. Required hands, bearing position and line of effect still apply. Ordinary surviving physical functions remain under suppression; magical enhancements and activations do not. Missing primary structure cannot be repaired by declaring a complete flag. Stowed books can preserve their words; they cannot assist a check without actual consultation. Melded equipment cannot be read, aimed, trigger a carried aura or issue commands.

EN dawn refill is the narrow internal-clock exception expressly defined in EN-06. Runes/scripts do not gain it. Existing prepared mundane work and committed damage/healing are not undone by later suppression. Ongoing magical wards/links follow their exact duration and suppression rules; clocks do not pause. Suppressed TI creatures are inert, not free mundane companions, and their operating block still expires.

Use one actual history ordered by campaign time, phase and sequence, one canonical roll/activation ID and current views for all registered competing sources. Spend at legal commitment, before rolls/interruption. Invalid declarations spend nothing; an actually committed effect that misses, is resisted, becomes illegal or is negated refunds nothing. No replay, backdating, ownership transfer, repair, rest or fresh display ID restores a past entitlement. Body/cargo placement, spilled contents, weight and Load remain real.
AC-06.verdictHeading: ## AC-06 — State, budgets, suppression and chronology

AC-07.title: Hands, bearing and explicit combination families
AC-07.text:
**Affected: all167 plus existing equipment interfaces. KEEP all actual class/source costs. NEW enrollments, not universal stacking rules:** EN weapon accuracy enters the existing Blacksmith/V6 item-accuracy comparison; EN armor enhancement and an active Rune ward's AC bonus enter `equipment.defense-enhancement`; Rune ward saves enter `equipment.jewel-save-enhancement`; actual relevant Scribing and TI utility check bonuses enter the existing equipment task-enhancement family used by Jewelcrafting/Leatherworking/Tailoring (`equipment.leather-task-enhancement`). Compare eligible values once; never add the same benefit under a renamed family. An assistant's item does not donate its personal bonus to the lead.

EN weapon's newly defined flat ordinary damage bonus is scoped to its own one-imprint weapon, not a second passive on another weapon. EN pulse enhancement is already in its own fixed attack expression. Rune effects do not add their bonus again to an EN attack or to a creature's base AC formula. Existing unrelated class/spell modifiers retain their own exact combination rules; no global strongest-only rule is enacted.

A held active item requires its stated hand(s). No “Focus” title supplies class F permission; only an independent actual class source may authorize it. Spell S/F hand compatibility remains the equipment rule. Rune wards occupy one actual wrist, neck or chest jewelry-bearing position as defined in RC-07, shared with the existing seven-position jewelry scheme; no extra free slots from different trade names. Other ground runes, books and tools have no passive wearable slot benefit.
AC-07.verdictHeading: ## AC-07 — Hands, bearing and explicit combination families

AC-08.title: User, owner, creator and permission are different
AC-08.text:
**Affected: all167.** Buying an item grants no proficiency, class levels, formula, spell repertoire, Tinker modules, creature source rights or alignment. A capable ordinary user can operate an EN item, arm a Rune/TI trap, consult readable records or command an already legitimately bound craft automaton under the NEW procedures. Their checks still use only their actual training. Scribing casting has its explicit narrower caster gate. Servicing and restoration require the stated trained credential.

Familiars and ordinary craft automata receive no general item-activation, spellcasting, signing, attunement or artisan-work permission from possession; their source-defined task/action set still controls. An actual independently permitted actor may use an item with its own hands/actions/budgets, not the maker's except687's explicit Engineering snapshot. Creature-control effects keep prohibitions on compelled finite-resource spending and permanent allegiance; a controller does not rewrite an item's owner, source maker, lease or service history.

A thief's physical possession can permit ordinary non-owner-locked hand use; it does not establish legal ownership, consent, knowledge of command protocols or authority over another construct. No damage or new curse follows merely from theft. Legitimate transfer of TI command registration is separately defined, not inferred from a sale price.
AC-08.verdictHeading: ## AC-08 — User, owner, creator and permission are different

AC-09.title: Restoration is not recharge, service, resurrection or new crafting
AC-09.text:
**Affected: all167. KEEP the reviewed repair/reference framework; NEW advanced bridge:** use the recipe's actual trained primary trade credential and INT, a real compatible source station and the original required repair implements. For an EN weapon/armor, the facility must also supply the actual host-compatible repair fixtures/tools; this limited restoration permission does not teach Smithing or manufacture a missing blade/mail body. A broken target cannot supply its own missing working toolkit.

Functional repair: DC10; `max(1 hour, current recorded maximumHP/10 hours)`; actual compatible material reference **25% of the admitted undamaged mundane body reference**. Broken/wrecked but recoverable original: original recipe DC; `max(8 hours, recorded maximumHP/10 hours)`; materials **25% of the undamaged finished per-unit reference**. Apply Core task natural shifts, then collapse to success/failure; no extra critical result, crafting quality, XP, catalysts or Forge Dwarf discount. Failure spends real materials/time; a further attempt needs new work/materials. Generic repair assistants add no bonus.

Success restores existing maximum HP and otherwise lawful functionality, never spent charges, service encounters, spell uses, pact entitlements, dawn events, programmed permissions or flaws. For TI creatures use source creature maximum, not a convenient B5 object quotation. Exact class repair/reconstruction exceptions apply only under the TD matrix; their actual paid resources and restrictions replace the ordinary route where they genuinely apply.

Require the original primary members in the body catalogue and original creation record. Original inscribed page/plate fields must still exist; burnt/missing pages, missing frame/actuator, terminal dismantling, consumed debris or a copied inscription cannot be reconstructed by paying a percentage. Replace only subordinate grips/covers/fasteners/contact inserts explicitly allowed. No old process catalyst must retroactively survive separately. A real available reviewed repair service is an alternative complete quote, not a second fee.

Finished reference = **source recommendedMarketValue / source Standard Q + actual admitted mundane body reference**, exact until final purchase-ceiling/sale-floor copper rounding. Do not divide by quality yield, regenerate source labor, add reusable capital each time, replace current values with legacy values or guarantee a buyer. Commission50% applies to the agreed actual quote. Body ownership avoids repurchase, not the physical reserve requirement. All advanced magical bodies, even spent/suppressed/Broken ones, remain outside generic mundane-only dismantling without a separate lawful profile.
AC-09.verdictHeading: ## AC-09 — Restoration is not recharge, service, resurrection or new crafting

AC-10.title: Source preservation, public projection and exact-review gate
AC-10.text:
**Affected:100public/7restricted/60Director-only advanced recipes. KEEP audiences exactly.** Public sets: EN121–144,148; RC396–416; SC471–494,497,500,672,673; TI585–608,684,685. Restricted: EN147,150; RC422,423; SC498; TI609,611. Every other recipe in this 167 register remains Director-only, including developed/needsReview=false outliers. No raw source status implies operational approval or public release.

Preserve all100 six-paragraph book bindings, all four versions and Rune name differences. Operational JSON/manuscript must express exactly the same full behavior and source requirement envelope. Public body and rule dependencies must match internal operational counterparts but omit private membership lists, custom667/674/675/686/687 dossiers and hidden metadata not needed by a public recipe.

The public dependency union contains **15 of the22 physical defaults/size variants**: EN-armor/weapon/wand/staff/charm; RC-plate; SC-book/text/sheet; TI-trap/auto-tiny/auto-small/tool/device/sensor. The seven private-only defaults EN-sigil/focus/seal, RC-seal, SC-scroll, TI-drone and TI-ram remain internal. A genuinely public existing alternative EN host keeps its own preexisting equipment authority, not private recipe membership.

Use the accepted gathering fail-closed component-envelope approach: retain every printed occurrence, quantity, role and consumption; expose supplemental material metadata only with independent public authority. A printed ingredient name is not a dossier publication or acquisition license. A withheld field is not a wildcard/zero/ordinary replacement: bind stock privately by exact recipe+component index and actual source identity. Publicly needed operating precision, Rune correspondence, charge/use rules, bodies and costs cannot be hidden as though they were private donor lore. No duplicate host or reagent can be inferred from an incomplete public preview.

The remaining dependencies are the real facts needed to run these rules: actual materials/permissions/containment, actual spell payloads, factual text/language content, eligible mechanisms and genuine sealed-passage profiles. These do not prevent writing complete bounded cards now. Runtime, full bestiary/expedition integration, human balance, whole-game flow and later release remain separate. Literal hidden lore remains preserved and nonoperative where its own review is deferred.
AC-10.verdictHeading: ## AC-10 — Source preservation, public projection and exact-review gate

EN-01.title: Nine families, fixed host categories
EN-01.text:
**Affected:121–159,636–639. NEW bindings; source strengths/charges remain literal.** Enchanted Weapon modifies one admitted actual ordinary weapon, default longsword; Enchanted Armor modifies one actual ordinary armor suit, default chain shirt. Preserve the selected model's ordinary attack/armor rules, proficiencies, hands, properties, fit, physical defenses and grade. An armor family is not a shield, body tattoo or innate creature AC. The allowed alternative weapon is an actual separately tracked catalog weapon with an ordinary attack profile, not ammunition, a natural attack, a creature, an automaton or a net whose source has no damage attack.

Wand, Staff, Charm, Sigil, Focus and Seal use their own handheld bodies in the catalogue. Staff is not automatically quarterstaff; Focus is not automatically a spellcasting focus. The ten **generic Enchantment** recipes128,130,138,143,146,150,156,158,159,639 choose **weapon, armor suit or the EN-charm body** before reserving the batch. That choice fixes both body/reference and charge profile; it is not a removable enchantment sticker. No output grants a free underlying armor/weapon or a second copy of the host.

Exact enhancement/charge groups: **+1/1:121–135; +1/2:136–144; +2/3:145–150; +2/4:151–155; +3/5:156–158,637; +3/6:159,636,638,639.** The original primary tag and damageType remain independent preserved fields; actual type used is the source damageType, not a legacy title or chosen alternative element.
EN-01.verdictHeading: ## EN-01 — Nine families, fixed host categories

EN-02.title: What enhancement improves
EN-02.text:
**NEW finite enhancement meaning:** on an EN weapon, B adds to that weapon's item-accuracy candidate and once to its ordinary weapon-damage component; no bonus to attacks with something else. Its ordinary B/P/S damage counts as magical while the imprint qualifies, following the explicit Blacksmith equipment convention. Flat damage does not double on criticals. On an EN armor suit, B is a defense-enhancement candidate only while that functional, unsuppressed suit supplies the selected worn-armor AC formula. On other EN bodies, B improves only their own EN pulse attack as EN-03 defines; it is not an all-skills, spell-attack, spell-DC, save or research bonus.

KEEP the actual negative-grade guard. A Crude selected suit's−1 and active EN+1 produce+1 in that family; suppressing the EN leaves−1, not a phantom zero. A Blacksmith-enhanced shield elsewhere can provide its stronger eligible family value and its separate ordinary shield AC; another unselected suit supplies no selected-suit enhancement. Independently eligible printed resistances remain governed by their own wearing rules. **Two recipe imprints on the same body are not admitted**, so an alleged same-suit Blacksmith+EN stack is rejected, not summed. Existing separate-body candidates and unrelated class effects retain their actual scopes.

EN-03.title: Three complete NEW charge profiles
EN-03.text:
Let B be source enhancement1/2/3 and D the exact source damageType. Every profile costs one actual charge at legal commitment. None is a spell, grants RP, changes a class casting ability, builds Refrain/Dissonance or clears an existing class cadence record. The actual class's idle/recovery rules remain otherwise unchanged.

| Host | Complete charge procedure |
|---|---|
| Weapon | **Charged Strike:** use an Action to make exactly one legal attack with that actual weapon, with normal ability/proficiency, reach/range, ammunition/loading, line of effect and target restrictions. It is not an Attack Action granting Extra Attack. Declare the charge before the attack roll. On hit add **B d6 of D** to that same attack's damage event; miss gives none. These rider dice double on that attack's ordinary natural20 critical; flat B does not. An off-hand or feature-provided separate attack cannot activate another Charged Strike without its own legal Action. |
| Armor suit | **Typed Guard:** when its capable wearer would take a positive resolved component of type D, after applicable defenses but before temporary/normal HP loss, spend the wearer's Reaction and one charge to reduce that component by **B d6**, minimum0. Applies once to that damage event, only to that actual type; no healing, later shield pool, counterattack, general resistance or reduction of unrelated typed components. Existing simultaneous reductions use normal declared event order and cannot reduce below0. |
| Wand/Staff/Charm/Sigil/Focus/Seal, or generic charm host | **Typed Pulse:** Action, one hand manipulating the actual implement, one perceived creature or physically damage-compatible object within **30ft**, clear line of effect. Ranged magical-item attack **d20+(4+B)** against actual AC. No additional user/creator ability or PB is added: the fixed+4 aiming term is NEW, and B is already included. Hit deals **2B d6 of D**, no flat damage. Natural20 doubles its attack dice; natural1 misses. No splash, condition, repeated pulse, spell focus effect or automatic object bypass. A staff still needs a physically compatible actual grip. |

One effect's components form one damage event, not extra hits for procs. For Typed Guard, "resolved component" means the provisional post-defense amount: finalize the reduction before applying HP loss or testing a trigger that requires positive damage actually taken. A component reduced to zero does not retrospectively count as positive damage taken. The armor option can be used only with actual Reaction capacity and a matching positive incoming component. Carrying or wearing multiple inactive handheld tokens does not grant their enhancement or combine pulse dice.
EN-03.verdictHeading: ## EN-03 — Three complete NEW charge profiles

EN-04.title: Exact type, no extra tag powers
EN-04.text:
KEEP all43 damageType fields. In particular Water produces **cold**, Vitality **radiant**, Stealth/Psychic **psychic**, Strength/Arcane **force**, Flora/Poison **poison**, Air **thunder**, Earth **bludgeoning**, Unholy **necrotic**; Fire/Cold/Acid/Lightning retain their exact typed fields. This table describes these source mappings, not a new global equivalence of tags.

Vitality does not heal; Stealth does not hide; Strength does not raise STR; Flora does not control plants; Water creates no drinkable water or freezing surface. Pulse damage against an object still meets physical compatibility and object immunity, including ordinary poison/psychic immunity. A matching element grants no immunity or affinity to the bearer.
EN-04.verdictHeading: ## EN-04 — Exact type, no extra tag powers

EN-05.title: Payment, defense, interruption and lost targets
EN-05.text:
KEEP Core attacks, defense ordering and actual Counterspell/Dispel scopes. All EN activations are **nonspell magical item effects** with no invented spell rank. Counterspell cannot target them just because the recipe spends a charge. An actual defense that covers the attack/item effect may prevent it; a spell-only trigger does not. No source name creates a countering reaction.

Before spending validate actual item state, charge, user action/reaction, target, range, hand and legal operation. Once legally committed, spent charge/action remains spent on miss, immunity, resistance, full prevention, actual interruption or later target departure. No target at declaration means no legal activation, not a forced waste. Suppression arriving before resolution prevents the magical part but refunds nothing; an ordinary already-made weapon attack resolves only to the extent its independent physical procedure still permits. Damage already applied is not undone if the item is subsequently suppressed. No charge is spent twice for one copied/replayed event, and a copy creates no fresh paid-activation or on-hit opportunity.
EN-05.verdictHeading: ## EN-05 — Payment, defense, interruption and lost targets

EN-06.title: Source dawn recharge, explicit clock adoption
EN-06.text:
**NEW EN adoption of the established Jewelcrafting dawn convention:** one fixed campaign epoch at06:00; dawn n occurs each86,400 campaign seconds. Use an EN-scoped `(campaignId,enchanting-dawn,n,itemId)` event, the same campaign clock, not a new local sunrise. Refill sets current to source maximum; it never adds maximum or banks surplus. No RP or consumables are required for this printed recharge.

A complete positive-HP unsuppressed EN item refills at its actual dawn, whether worn, stowed or melded; meld permits only this internal clock operation, not use. Suppressed/Broken/incomplete items do not refill and mark that dawn processed. Repair/unsuppression does not catch up a missed dawn. Process actual historical state and all preceding dawns before a later expenditure; no current state projected backward. Creation initializes once and cannot replay a coincident processed dawn. Charge use just before and after a real refill is legal. Travel, ownership, different skies, clock display changes, short/long rest and returning from meld grant no additional event. This explicitly extends the existing convention to EN only, not to Runes, scripts or Tinker servicing.
EN-06.verdictHeading: ## EN-06 — Source dawn recharge, explicit clock adoption

EN-07.title: One permanent imprint per host, no transfer/reset service
EN-07.text:
KEEP previous one-imprint and never-magically-altered reserve rules. EN cannot be overlaid on an existing Blacksmith/Jewel/gathering/other magical body through this conference, cannot overwrite another EN imprint, and cannot be peeled onto a fresh host to reset charges. A separately attached physical Rune plate is another real item with its own mass/slot; it is not a second imprint of the armor underneath.

Destroying/disabling an imprint does not convert its historically magical host into an admitted fresh reserve or create saleable extracted enchantment. Any future actual disenchantment/reimprinting procedure needs its own bounded source; ordinary authorship here is complete without it. Do not invent a new general dismantling right for these magic items.
EN-07.verdictHeading: ## EN-07 — One permanent imprint per host, no transfer/reset service

EN-08.title: Initial charges and manufacturing results
EN-08.text: Initialize the full printed C **per actual produced body**, once. A Q4 Standard batch creates four C-charge objects, not one shared4C pool or four bodies from one reusable focus. An Exceptional/Masterwork structural option changes only the actual structural maximum, not C/B/D. A singleton Flawed body can finish Broken with a recorded dormant initial C; repair exposes those existing charges, no refill. Source Q≥2 reduced yield adds no singleton flaw. EN has no invented reduced-duration activation option; instantaneous strike/pulse/guard remains instantaneous. Masterwork catalyst return is one actual eligible unit for the entire batch, not one per output or charge.
EN-08.verdictHeading: ## EN-08 — Initial charges and manufacturing results

EN-09.title: Consumed lenses versus actual working lens
EN-09.text: **637[1]** is one Tier9 Focusing lens at7,500gp/1lb, consumed. **639[3]** is one Tier10 Focusing lens at18,000gp/1lb, consumed. Preserve both full occurrences and their supply IDs. The actual retained Enchanter's kit/lens/stylus and station are separately necessary. The consumed lens cannot simultaneously fund the retained lens, a supplemental Focus body or another order; a cheap ordinary focusing lens does not satisfy its tiered ingredient identity. A nonconsumed component can overlap an actual kit implement only when the very same object meets both exact requirements and simultaneous availability. No role or price creates catalyst retention for these lenses.
EN-09.verdictHeading: ## EN-09 — Consumed lenses versus actual working lens

EN-10.title: Suggested titles do not add powers
EN-10.text: **636 Command Sigil** uses its six-charge+3 necrotic pulse; no command or binding power. **637 Core-Crystal Resonance Focus** uses five-charge+3 force pulse; no class spell focus or RP pool. **638 Sentient Memory Seal** uses six-charge+3 psychic pulse; no autonomous mind, archive, memory-reading or personality. **639 Winged Air Enchantment** uses its preregistered host profile, six-charge+3 thunder effect; no wings, flight or movement mode. These are exact dispositions of the actual generic effects, not requests for more source text. Preserve their names, wholeCreatureUse and private metadata literally; additional title-suggested powers are not authored here.
EN-10.verdictHeading: ## EN-10 — Suggested titles do not add powers

RC-01.title: Six families, one physical rune rather than a free site
RC-01.text:
**Affected:396–432,664–667. NEW bodies:** Binding, Explosive, Healing, Warding and generic Rune families use one RC-plate each;667 uses its larger RC-seal. Generic Rune family entries are **warding profiles**, not an unspecified fifth spell family. No direct inscription into a wearer, floor, entire door or armor is an alternate free body. A physical plate may be placed or strapped to that surface with actual support, becoming a separately tracked item. Parent and plate cannot both count the plate's material.

Placing a carried plate within5ft on stable support and arming it takes **one Action, one free hand**; an already placed plate can be armed with that Action. Its **one5ft trigger square** is declared at arming, containing the plate, unobstructed and currently unoccupied by an eligible entrant. Arming completes at the beginning of the armer's next regular turn, or after six elapsed seconds outside initiative. No placement under an occupying creature produces immediate entry. Disarming one's accessible plate uses an Action; removing it uses the actual item interaction afterward. A ward-bearing plate instead follows RC-07;667 follows RC-10.

A moved, rotated off its declared working face, wholly covered/closed-in-container, Broken, incomplete or suppressed triggered plate cannot produce a new trigger. Movement invalidates its placed trigger geometry and disarms it; merely uncovering/repairing/unsuppressing does not rearm. Existing Binding effects require the original unmoved eligible plate and end if it is moved, Broken, covered or suppressed. Already resolved damage/healing is unchanged. A door used as support opens/moves its plate and therefore disarms it; the rune does not turn the whole doorway into an untracked remote site.

RC-02.title: Entry, touch, occupancy and detection
RC-02.text:
**NEW event definition:** entry is one actual crossing from outside into the declared square/volume by walking, forced movement, falling or teleport arrival. Remaining inside, starting a turn there, an extra turn or retelling the same movement is not entry. A sufficiently large creature entering by any occupied portion is one entrant, not one per square/body part. Actual line of effect and contact geometry apply. Noncreature objects do not trigger creature-entry clauses.

Binding/Explosive trigger on the first eligible creature, including the setter or an ally; no unseen friend-or-foe filter. Order simultaneous entrants by the encounter's preregistered stable resolution order, not post-roll player choice. Healing instead requires its designated eligible ally and uses RC-06. The base runes are visible inscriptions when exposed; no Stealth/invisibility from names. A deliberate concealed installation needs actual cover and a legitimate ordinary concealment procedure, not an automatic hidden DC.

**NEW inspection/disarm:** one active minute within5ft with safe access permits INT/Arcana or INT/Runecarver's-tools examination against the original recipe creation DC, Core task collapsed to binary, to learn this actual rune's operating type/trigger, not donor lore. Failure grants no missing information or repeat on unchanged evidence. A trained Runecarver with actual tools may spend one minute to disarm an unknown accessible rune at that DC; failure leaves it armed and triggers one discharge only if the worker actually supplies an eligible entry/touch event declared in the work plan. No invented remote explosion from a failed identification. Destroying or safely covering the plate remains an actual physical alternative. These scopes grant neither Burglar nor Runic Scholar feat approval.

RC-03.title: Finite charges, manual rearming and no dawn
RC-03.text:
KEEP every printed charge count on the40 ordinary rune profiles. Initialize once; **no Rune recharge, refill, rest reset, rescribing renewal or generic charge servicing is authorized**. One legal trigger/ward activation spends one charge for its whole result. After a ground-rune discharge it disarms; another eligible Action and arming delay are required. Also at most one discharge by that physical plate in a numbered round (fixed six-second event windows outside initiative); rearming, owners and initiative entry cannot refresh that window. Simultaneous entrants cannot multiply the first spent charge.

Remaining occupants do not trigger when a plate is rearmed; the square must be cleared and a genuine later entry occur. One person may maintain **at most three armed ordinary ground runes** under this NEW placement limit; arming a fourth first requires deliberately disarming one already armed plate. Ward-bearing runes and667 are separate profiles, not extra copies of this limit. Spent plates remain real historically imprinted material, not fresh stock or recovered catalysts. Unknown historical charge balance is not assumed full.
RC-03.verdictHeading: ## RC-03 — Finite charges, manual rearming and no dawn

RC-04.title: Binding rune completion
RC-04.text:
Exact **DC/charges**:3969/1;40010/1;4019/1;4058/1;41215/2;41317/2;42622/4;66520/4. Source STR save remains binary without natural shifts. Failure applies reviewed **Restrained for at most60 elapsed seconds**; success gives no restraint. Any creature with actual physical occupancy and no applicable condition immunity may be a target; no hidden size, ancestry or tag immunity is invented.

**NEW escape/end conditions:** target repeats that STR save at each of its regular-turn ends, ending on success. It may instead spend its Action on STR/Athletics or DEX/Acrobatics against the same DC, Core task collapsed to binary, to escape. A capable helper within5ft may use an Action and STR/Athletics with actual access at that DC. No concentration is required. Moving the target completely outside the trigger square/volume ends this local tether; restraint does not become immunity to otherwise legal forced movement/teleportation. Moving/covering/suppressing/Breaking the plate ends its restraint; ending creates no refund. Multiple restraints remain separately tracked without compounding the condition or preventing escape from each actual source. This is not whole-Action hard denial or an invented Stun.

RC-05.title: Explosive runes: full failure, zero on save
RC-05.text:
Exact profiles: **397 2d6force/DC11/C1;410 4d6acid/16/C2;418 6d6lightning/18/C3;429 10d6bludgeoning/24/C5;430 10d6acid/23/C5;666 8d6fire/20/C4.** These are printed source dice/types/DCs, not regenerated from tier.

One entry spends one charge and bursts **10ft radius centered on the physical rune**, including every actual creature in that geometry with line of effect, including allies, setter and entrant. Every recipient makes its own source DEX save: failure printed damage, **success0**, not assumed half. No attack roll or critical damage. Total cover blocks; partial cover applies only through its actual Core rule. The source does not include collateral objects, so the burst does not automatically destroy the rune, gear, doors or other traps. No persistent Burning, Poisoned, deafness, push or elemental terrain follows. Actual separately triggered effects still need their own source; this burst does not automatically activate creature-entry runes.
RC-05.verdictHeading: ## RC-05 — Explosive runes: full failure, zero on save

RC-06.title: Healing runes, consent and zero HP
RC-06.text:
Exact source healing/charges: **3991d8+2/C1;415,4162d8+4/C2;4224d8+6/C3;425,4276d8+8/C4;43210d8+12/C6.** Unholy/Grave names do not reverse healing.

**NEW ally binding:** at arming register up to six actually known individual allied identities, including the setter if desired, with their actual permission to receive ordinary healing. A later owner cannot retroactively replace them without disarming/rearming. One designated still-living ally triggers by actual entry, or spends an Action to touch the accessible placed plate. A capable helper may spend an Action to bring its working face into contact with a designated willing or Incapacitated living ally within5ft; this is the specific direct-touch exception to RC-01's stationary entry geometry, not a free moving entry aura, and spends one charge/disarms it. The helper deliberately declares that one touch before moving the plate; it does not also trigger other creatures crossed along the path. For direct-touch use an unarmed plate may have its same six-or-fewer allied identities set or replaced with one setup Action before the separate healing Action; no standing-area trigger exists until the ordinary placement/arming procedure is completed. The one-discharge-per-item-per-round guard still applies.

Apply normal ordinary healing eligibility, actual blockers/modifiers/HP caps and Critical/Wound rules. A living dying ally at0 may receive healing; a Dead/destroyed creature cannot. These runes grant no mechanical-device reconstruction. A construct is eligible only if its actual independent profile permits ordinary healing; TI-07's new machines do not. Ordinary healing applies to an eligible active ancestry/creature through its existing living-healing treatment, not by religious title. Unwilling active creatures cannot be forcibly touch-healed through this procedure. A legally committed heal spends its charge even at fullHP or when healing is prevented; no overflow, Wound cure, resurrection or extra charge is supplied by the rune itself.
RC-06.verdictHeading: ## RC-06 — Healing runes, consent and zero HP

RC-07.title: Warding attunement and pre-roll Reaction
RC-07.text:
**Affected:**398,402–404,406–409,411,414,417,419–421,423,424,428,431,664. KEEP each exact B/C. **NEW narrow Rune attunement:** ten uninterrupted active minutes personally handling the complete available plate binds one capable consenting bearer. No proficiency, class or generic magic-item attunement pool is granted. One bearer may be attuned to **one** of these wards; binding another releases the first without resetting it. One plate has one bearer. Death ends the bond; incapacity/suppression does not transfer it.

The ward must occupy one legal **wrist, neck or chest** position in the existing jewelry-bearing scheme, sharing that position with existing Jewelcrafting/other actual slot rules. Its included strap permits fitting, not extra positions. Don/doff/redesignation uses an Action and actual fitting; attunement does not put it on. No passive B applies just because it is worn.

When an attack legally targets the bearer, or an actual event requires the bearer's saving throw (including an area), the capable bearer may spend **one Reaction and one charge before that attack/save is rolled**. Gain B to AC and saves through the **start of their next regular turn**, including that initiating roll. No declaration after seeing a roll/damage, no second Reaction, no benefit for another target. Reaction loss at0 ordinarily prevents self-activation; another bearer cannot activate it for them. Apply AC-07's existing enhancement families separately to AC and saves. A ward may qualify for one comparison but lose another; its spent charge is not refunded.

RC-08.title: Endpoints, stacking, extra turns and suppression
RC-08.text:
Use the bearer's canonical next regular-turn-start marker; extra/attached turns do not expire or extend it. Before the bearer's first initiative turn, the next scheduled regular start is still its endpoint. Outside initiative, the NEW next-start convention is the next six-second bearer marker, anchored at declaration and not reset on entering initiative. The effect gives no extra turn or Reaction.

Repeated applications never add B. There is one attuned ward, one actual Reaction, and existing AC/save candidates remain individually eligible. Unattuning, removing from the designated position, melding, Broken/incomplete state or suppression suspends the ward benefit; its original expiry still runs, no retroactive recomputation/refund. Ending suppression before expiry can restore only the remaining original benefit if all other predicates still hold. A missed attack or successful save spends the charge. No new source affinity or global bonus rule is created.
RC-08.verdictHeading: ## RC-08 — Endpoints, stacking, extra turns and suppression

RC-09.title: Exact current names and limited historical correspondence
RC-09.text:
**Required-tool correspondence:** current public **396–416** say `Resonance lens`; their old versions and generic trade say `Focusing crystal`. **Consumed-component correspondence:**399[1],400[0],401[1],403[1],407[0],409[0],413[1],415[0] say current `Resonance Lens` versus historical `Focusing Crystal`, retaining their original ingredient IDs/tier/quantity/value/mass/role/consumption. Preserve both names and the58 name-only version differences;167 other differences are absentV2 visibility. Do not overwrite any source or globally rename crystals to lenses.

**NEW exact binding:** for the21 listed working-tool requirements only, a physically suitable ordinary focusing optic from an actual Runecarver's kit satisfies both historical/current labels. The completed ordinary optic is a clear shaped crystal element2×1×0.25in,0.25lb,5HP/AC13; standalone reference2gp, no power. It is included, not added, when that actual existing25gp/5lb kit is supplied: stylus0.25lb, optic0.25lb, fitted durable case/holder4.5lb. Its holder is not spare cargo. The kit gains no numeric bonus or consumed reagent.

For the eight ingredient occurrences, authorize **only the explicit recorded historical-name alias on that exact occurrence/source identity**. Old-name stock must have the same tier, properties, form, unit mass and authentic identity; name correspondence alone is insufficient. The consumed0.1-lb source component does not become the retained0.25-lb ordinary working optic or waive a required quantity. The ten other consumed `Focusing Crystal` occurrences remain literally that name; no alias is propagated to them or another trade. An unavailable matching ingredient stays unavailable, not replaced by cheap glass.
RC-09.verdictHeading: ## RC-09 — Exact current names and limited historical correspondence

RC-10.title: Custom recipe667, not a generic rechargeable ward
RC-10.text:
Preserve source **one hour,20ft,DC28 CHA, actual aberrations/extraplanar creatures, teleportation/incorporeality restrictions**, its missing charges field and exact private matrix metadata. **NEW operational use budget:** one lifetime activation, stored separately as `lifetimeActivations=1`, not a fabricated source charges value. Action with one hand within5ft on a properly placed complete RC-seal activates the stationary field; no concentration. One hour begins at activation. It cannot be moved to sweep targets: moving it ends the field and its activation remains spent. Suppression/cover/Broken prevents its field while that state applies; expiry runs and restoring state grants only any remaining lawful duration, never a fresh hour.

The ward affects only creatures within20ft and line of effect whose actual governing classification establishes one of the printed target labels. It does not classify people by appearance, ancestry, lore guesses or an unknown flag. It creates no new cosmology list. On an affected creature's **actual attempt to teleport or begin an incorporeal state/movement**, make one binary DC28 CHA save for that attempted effect. Success permits only that actual otherwise legal attempt; failure blocks it and leaves its already committed costs spent. No action/resource-free testing save, no recurring save merely for standing there, no immunity for the whole hour after one success. One save covers one whole actual teleport/incorporeal movement attempt, not a new save at every five-foot increment of that same movement. Failure prevents the restricted attempt, not unrelated ordinary corporeal movement. A continuing corporeal position is not forcibly altered; an already-incorporeal creature is not ejected into a wall. If it later tries a new incorporeal movement through the ward, that is a new actual restricted attempt. Involuntary teleportation of an eligible creature inside the field uses that creature's save; arrival by a source originating wholly outside the field is not retroactively prevented by checking a destination after arrival.

Its limits do not prevent ordinary walking, flight, forced movement or break an unrelated spell/portal. An actual source that ignores such a ward retains its own precedence; an unprovided target/teleport/incorporeal profile cannot be invented. This completes the ordinary ward algorithm while leaving classification and those actual effect records as bounded execution dependencies. Matrical-adjacent/Matrix references remain preserved, not interpreted or activated as research.
RC-10.verdictHeading: ## RC-10 — Custom recipe667, not a generic rechargeable ward

SC-01.title: Nine body families; authentic content, then one encoded payload
SC-01.text:
**Affected:471–506,672–675. NEW body/content completion.** Tome/Book/Codex/Lexicon use SC-book; Text/Formula SC-text; Map/Diagram SC-sheet; Scroll SC-scroll. Those are nine distinct source-family bindings, not nine free spellbooks. A source Codex remains that recipe identity even when it shares an ordinary body model. Existing Book/journal/paper/parchment values are explicit body references; a title supplies no language, map, formula, ancient fact or actual spell effect.

The22 script outputs are manufactured as **blank, loadable magical carriers**, with one payload slot and their original maximum rank/use capacity. A seller must distinguish blank from genuinely loaded. Before encoding, record one actual complete operational spell/ritual, its precise source ID/version, class/school placement, class-specific rank and authentic readable text. A qualified source supplier must actually know/have legitimate access to that text; a title, summary, photograph-shaped ID or unfinished spell record is insufficient. No researched formula or known spell is invented by the carrier.

**NEW encoding service:** trained Calligrapher's supplies, INT, actual Scribe's Desk/quill/straightedge, authentic source and accessible blank original carrier; active time `max(1,rank) hours`, mundane ink/scribing service supplies `max(1,rank) sp` and `0.01×max(1,rank) lb`. These are separately NEW finite supplied consumables, not edits to the original recipe bill. One Core task collapsed to binary at **DC10+rank**. Success fixes that one payload and initializes no additional uses; failure spends supplies/time and leaves the payload unusable, permitting another actual encoding attempt with new work/supplies. No crafting XP, catalyst retention, Forge Dwarf reduction or spell cast occurs while encoding. A forced interruption loses the incomplete encoding phase while physical losses remain. The original lifetime use balance is never restored.

A loaded carrier cannot be overwritten with a different spell, upgraded or refilled through this procedure. Erasure/damage leaves it spent/unusable as appropriate, not blank-for-a-new-initialization. One carrier holds one spell/ritual, even when uses=2. Ordinary reference content must be separately real, authenticated as far as the source actually supports, and fixed to one declared subject/area/system when the source requires one.
SC-01.verdictHeading: ## SC-01 — Nine body families; authentic content, then one encoded payload

SC-02.title: All22 use-count questions explicitly disposed
SC-02.text:
Adopt each original numeric uses field as **NEW lifetime legally committed cast-start activations of that physical carrier**, not number of stored spells, readings, charges per reader or research consultations. Prose capacity remains one payload. Uses are spent at a legal activation's commitment, whether the subsequent spell succeeds, misses, is saved against or countered.

SC-03.title: Exact casting gate; named narrow repertoire addition
SC-03.text:
**NEW `script-temporary-repertoire` rule:** an authentic loaded operational script may supply its **one stored spell as a temporary repertoire/prepared choice for that activation only**. This is an explicit narrow addition to `M/SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md`'s ordinary actual-repertoire requirement, not a claim that owning a source text already granted that exception. It teaches nothing permanently, expands no known/prepared capacity after activation, and applies to none of the18 references. All other class gates remain unchanged.

The activating caster must possess the actual stored class/school placement, that class's minimum level/rank access, sufficient current RP/other actual casting resource, legal components/actions/targets and the ability to read/understand the encoded text. The stored placement is fixed at encoding; a different class's lower rank cannot be substituted mid-use. Its class-specific rank must be within the carrier cap. A noncaster or ineligible class cannot activate it. No generic UMD roll, level check, accidental backlash or noncaster RP pool is added. Unfinished ordinary spells and unranked/uncompleted rituals cannot be loaded by treating absent rank/effect fields as zero.

Use the actual spell's casting time, Action/BA/Reaction trigger, range, components, concentration, target count, attack/DC and interruption procedure. The script must be open and readable in hand or on actual support within5ft throughout required reading; a stowed/closed/melded script is inaccessible. Reading creates no free object retrieval or extra hands; class F permission still needs its own actual focus and normal S/F hand rules. No extra universal verbal component is invented beyond the actual spell.

At legal cast start spend **one script use plus all normal RP/material/class costs**. The script substitutes only the narrow repertoire/prepared gate, not RP, costly components, Dissonance surcharge, concentration or source per-rest limits. Apply that caster's actual spell attack/DC, Dissonance and Refrain once, using the stored spell's real name; switching physical books does not reset same-name cadence. A ritual requires its actual ritual-use permission and full duration/cost rules. No generic upcasting: only a separately authorized version that was actually encoded and within the cap. Readied activation uses the existing one-cast chronology; release is not a second script use/cast. An actual Counterspell can counter this spell; a countered cast refunds no script use or other cost.

Thus insufficient RP, wrong class, missing components, inaccessible text or no legal trigger blocks commitment without expenditure. A legally committed later failure spends the use. This is a complete container/use procedure; the actual operational payload is a bounded per-load execution dependency, not another advanced-recipe source conference.
SC-03.verdictHeading: ## SC-03 — Exact casting gate; named narrow repertoire addition

SC-04.title: Copies, shared readers and identity
SC-04.text:
Copying ordinary legible permitted information follows its actual writing/formula-learning procedure. A copy, rubbing or image can preserve information and provenance, but not the original magical enhancement, encoded activation, Language Insight evidence entitlement or per-expedition reroll. Photography is not an independent game capability granted here. A new magically enhanced copy requires its own complete recipe creation/bodies/inputs; it does not duplicate the same physical manuscript.

Sharing the one original lets different qualified readers consult its actual text at different real times; one person's research bonus does not apply to another's lead roll because an assistant holds it. Script uses and map rerolls remain per physical item, not reader. Once the last script use is spent, rewriting that pattern is not replenishment. A permanent spell-learning/copying attempt from surviving text still requires its actual class procedure, source access and costs; this source conference supplies no free learned spell or formula.

SC-05.title: Relevant content and finite consultation

Old maps may help only where their information remains genuinely useful; contradictions/unknowns remain and actual task difficulty is not erased. Fiction can support research on that fiction, not automatically real-world navigation or a hidden mechanism.

A numerical research bonus qualifies only when the **lead personally consults the actual relevant legible record for at least one active minute**, or the whole otherwise explicitly shorter task, during a genuinely necessary information step; for a long task this minute is inside its existing actual work. The item must remain available, functional and unsuppressed at the check. Merely carrying, opening for a token glance or reading irrelevant pages fails. Short tasks without the required consultation need actual prior preparation incorporated in that same declared task, not retroactive free reading.

Scripts' printed research bonuses apply only to an actual relevant Arcana/History/Religion/Nature/Engineering research task. Plain texts use their actual subject. Maps/diagrams apply their printed bonus to relevant navigation, Engineering or research concerning their actual recorded area/system. No bonus to attack, save, spell DC, spellcasting, every INT check, unrelated investigation, manufacture or repair from the word research. Their authoring/copying/encoding, or creating a new bonus-granting reference from that same object, receives no self-production bonus. A relevant actual formula-research task can qualify without granting a successful new formula automatically. Use AC-07's scoped task family and one actual PB/assistance source contribution.

SC-08.title: NEW bounded Language Insight completion and recipe674
SC-08.text:
The supplied governing files mention translation progress but **do not supply a complete Language Insight currency/spend procedure**. Complete that specific gap here; do not label these numbers as recovered rules or invent an entire language-learning system.

**NEW Language Insight ledger:** points are recorded per researcher and one identified target language, maximum **six unspent points per language**. After **one active hour** of genuine study of a legible, authenticated, useful parallel text into a language that researcher understands,498/500 may grant their one point;674 grants **three** toward its one preregistered actual ancient language. The same underlying evidence/correspondences grant their points **once per researcher**, shared across original/copies, other physical editions and magically remade books using the same content. The reader/underlying evidence ID, not the current holder ID, is the anti-repeat key. Different readers can learn from the same real work; points cannot be transferred or sold as another character's comprehension. Saturation gives no substitute reward or later deferred excess.

**NEW finite use:** spend **three Insight for that language** and **eight active hours** of actual study with the evidence to translate one preregistered passage of at most **250 words** into a language the researcher knows. The passage must genuinely exist, be accessible/legible, and be covered by the evidence's actual vocabulary/correspondence; the Director must possess or establish the real source meaning. It grants that passage's supported literal translation, not general spoken fluency, hidden truths, deciphering a separate cipher or permission to learn a spell. Missing or unsupported meaning leaves the project unqualified before spending; it is not solved by a fabricated Insight result. This is a new specific translation procedure, not a reset of ordinary research progress or automatic completion of an unrelated project. The eight hours are work, not rest or Forge Dwarf creation. Use this specific Insight translation route or an independently authorized ordinary Translate project; the same active hours do not also award a second project's progress, an Insight gain or recipe XP.

674's **+3 cross-disciplinary research** applies only to genuine research requiring at least two of its printed five disciplines, with one declared lead check using the relevant actual skill and the normal assistance/proficiency rules. An eight-hour investigation at **NEW DC20** may examine an actually recorded ordinary cross-disciplinary correspondence: Core success reveals only the supported relation, failure no reliable new relation, critical no invented lore. Another attempt needs new evidence/method. It neither creates secret content nor operates its separate latent Matrix metadata. Its three points are not three new languages, per-day points or a spellcasting bonus.

This completes usable Insight behavior without approving the pending language feats. Additional ordinary fluency courses remain outside the recipe's promise, not a blocker to authoring674.
SC-08.verdictHeading: ## SC-08 — NEW bounded Language Insight completion and recipe674

SC-09.title: Custom675: finite willing bargain and mark
SC-09.text:
KEEP one bargain, willing creatures, **6d10 psychic** breach and **30-day mark**; no spell/save/DC/charge field is silently added to the source. **NEW operating limits:** one lifetime bargain in this physical Codex, **two to six capable willing signatories**, at most **three objective clauses**, one specified start and deadline no later than **30 elapsed days** after final signature. All parties must be present within5ft, personally comprehend the entire text and consequences, and freely assent without compulsion, coercion, deception about the terms or inability to consent. Spend **ten active minutes** of actual reading/signing with the complete accessible unsuppressed Codex. Only the final legal signature commits its one bargain. A corpse, ordinary low-INT automaton, name without an actual signer, proxy or forged signature cannot consent.

Before commitment fix the exact parties, permitted actions/omissions, observability/evidence, deadline, impossibility exceptions and resolution order. Ambiguous, internally contradictory, inherently impossible, secretly changing or belief/emotion-detection clauses are not eligible. The codex is not an oracle, truth spell, ownership transfer, universal legal court or soul contract. Subsequent unavoidable impossibility not caused by a party's voluntary breach excuses that party's impossible performance; disputed facts require actual Director adjudication of the preregistered objective terms, not an unsupported caller boolean. Ordinary legal effects and fictional enforceability remain separate from this one agreed magical consequence.

**NEW enforcement range:** a breach can trigger only while the original operative Codex and that actual signatory are within one mile in the same established campaign world, with their actual locations recorded. The effect does not require visual contact, but it supplies no detection, evidence gathering or planar link; the pre-agreed objective facts still require genuine adjudication. Outside that scope there is no trigger or queued later punishment for that past event. A later different proven breach within scope may spend an otherwise unused entitlement. An already applied mark retains its own30-day deadline outside the range. Moving the Codex does not restart covenant or mark clocks.

**First proven voluntary breach by each signatory while the covenant is active and within that enforcement scope** spends that signatory's one breach entitlement, inflicts6d10 psychic through actual defenses as one nonspell magical damage event, and applies the mark even if damage is fully prevented. No save is added to a willingly accepted consequence. Repeated breaches, multiple clauses, repairs and extra turns cannot deal it again to that signer. At most six such events per Codex. The mark is a visible magical identifying sigil on one agreed physically possible patch of the violator's actual body or shell, selected at signing, not on a removable carried identification plate. Clothing can conceal it, but discarding clothing does not remove it. A later permitted form change preserves that same creature's mark and remaining deadline without granting any remote identification or tracking power. It supplies no tracking, compelled behavior, damage pulse, penalties, forced allegiance or extra target vulnerability. It is not automatically the generic Marked condition or a curse by name.

The mark expires30 elapsed days after its actual application. Earlier consensual release requires the original functional Codex, all surviving competent signatories' informed assent and ten active minutes; it ends future enforcement and its still-active marks, never refunds use or damage. An independently reviewed effect explicitly able to remove this kind of nonspell magical mark may apply within its real scope; no invented spell rank is assigned for a rank-limited dispel. Otherwise use release/expiry, not an unknown-tier automatic cure.

Enforcement follows only events in the same established campaign world/identity history; this rule creates no planar reach, cross-world tracking or cosmological transport. Suppression, unreadable/incomplete primary pages or Broken state suspends **future** enforcement while duration runs. Missed breaches are not queued or replayed on repair. Irrecoverable destruction ends future enforcement; marks already applied retain their own duration/removal. Fulfillment/deadline ends future enforcement, not already applied marks. A copy cannot enforce another covenant or restore a spent one.

**NEW ordinary-annotation reader gate:** a researcher of character level11 or higher with actual proficiency in at least three of Arcana/History/Religion/Nature/Engineering may spend one active hour studying675 to perceive its one actually provided ordinary hidden annotation. This is one bounded local reading, not automatically the Matrix clue in its separately preserved metadata. With no actual authorized annotation content, reveal no invented message. The latent Matrix object and literal wording remain preserved and nonoperative pending their own later gate.
SC-09.verdictHeading: ## SC-09 — Custom675: finite willing bargain and mark

TI-02.title: Mechanical trap deployment and trigger
TI-02.text:
**Affected:**585,588,592,598,599,601,605,609,610,613,619. Keep each printed die/type/source DEX-save DC/C from the register. **NEW deployment:** one minute, both hands, actual Tinker's tools and stable accessible support within5ft. Select one unoccupied5ft ground square containing the mechanism; no vertical mine, thrown grenade or under-occupant activation. Arming then uses an Action and completes at the setter's next regular start/six elapsed seconds. Up to **three** of these traps may be armed by one registered setter at once; disarm one before a fourth. Mounting alone is not an attack or a source of camouflage.

First actual creature entry, including an ally, forced movement, teleport arrival or fall, is the trigger. Objects, narrative movement inside and continuous occupancy are not entry. The mechanism is visible under normal viewing conditions; actual independent concealment requires its own real work/check. It targets **one entrant** in stable preregistered event order. Spend one charge; source DEX save: failure full printed damage, success0. No half damage, area, extra condition, Burning or tag immunity. A discharge disarms the trap; another actual Action/arming delay and cleared square are needed. At most one discharge per physical trap per numbered round/fixed six-second window.

**NEW explicit device-ledger bridge:** an automatic damaging discharge also consumes the registered setter's shared offensive-device allowance for that numbered round, but no Bonus Action. It does not provide an independent device turn. If that allowance is already used, no discharge, charge cost or queued later attack occurs; a future genuinely eligible entry is needed. Death/incapacity of the setter does not create a new owner/round allowance or disable a physically self-triggering installed trap by itself. Its fixed original setter/event history remains. This preserves the current shared device offense limit while giving the crafted source a concrete automatic trigger. Rune plates are non-device wards under their own RC trigger limits, not Tinker class deployables.

A capable authorized setter can safely disarm their accessible trap with an Action. **NEW other disarming:** trained thieves' tools or Tinker's tools, DEX or INT chosen to match the physical method, one active minute, DC=printed trap save DC, Core task collapsed to binary. Failure leaves it armed; an actual declared disturbance that meets the entry/trigger mechanism may discharge once against that worker, subject to its actual charge/offense allowance. No remote trigger from merely failing to notice. Moving a trap disarms it; ordinary actual damage can Break it but creates no automatic detonation or recovered charge.

TI-03.title: All18 basic attacks, not Anacite statistics
TI-03.text:
KEEP each printed AC, HP, damage type in the **source effect prose**, and N encounters before service. The mechanics objects omit damageType on these18; do not erase the printed types merely because the numeric object omits them. **NEW complete attack:** one melee attack, reach5ft, attack bonus **2+N**, hit **N d6 of the printed type**, no added ability damage, no rider, no free second attack. These new magnitudes use N as an explicit authored lookup, not a previously printed scaling rule. Against a perceived creature or independently attack-eligible ordinary object, use actual AC, cover/reach and physical/type defenses; natural1 misses and natural20 doubles attack dice. This is nonspell magical damage, with no spell rank, casting or Counterspell window.

Tiny: STR6,DEX12,CON10,INT3,WIS10,CHA1; walk20ft. Small: STR12,DEX10,CON12,INT3,WIS10,CHA1; walk25ft. Saves/checks use those modifiers, no PB or expertise by default; Perception passive10, ordinary sight/hearing with no darkvision, blindsight, telepathy or through-wall sensing. TI-04.title: Control, binding, orders and finite active count
TI-04.text:
**NEW crafted control protocol:** a capable consenting user with INT6+ and actual access to the nonhostile unbound chassis may spend ten active minutes with Tinker's tools to register one controller and one simple task; no proficiency is granted or required merely to use a known functioning control interface. An already bound item requires its existing controller's actual release or a separately completed lawful control procedure. Ownership alone does not hack hostile/unknown/locked machinery. Transfer preserves service/HP/use histories and consumes the same ten minutes; no combat rebind for another action.

A controller may have **three active crafted automata** among the18 ordinary profiles, plus at most **one active686 coordinator** under its own exception. Additional owned machines must be deactivated, carried/stored with their real mass, or actually transferred to a capable different controller. They do not consume class Anacite/deployable slots and cannot become extra class-slot capacity. Class limits remain separately applicable, and **one shared command and one offensive companion/device allowance per owner per numbered round** applies across both systems. Deactivation/rebinding does not refund a round's spent allowance.

Command: Bonus Action on the controller's regular turn, target within60ft with actual visible/audible control communication and lawful access. Choose that machine's one eligible move plus one basic attack or one programmed task action. It executes after the controller's whole turn in the existing attached phase; no independent initiative turn, Reaction or recharge. Uncommanded active machines may move defensively and Dodge only; they do not obey a standing kill/harvest/attack order. Failed execution consumes the committed command/offense allowance; later controller incapacity alone does not cancel it, but source ending, suppression, exhausted power or an illegal target can prevent execution.

Outside initiative a programmed task must be a deterministic physically possible sequence using its actual appendages: carry one identified supported item along an already traversable specified route, operate one known ordinary lever, or sort a finite identified set by a visible physical property. No unseen search/identification, discretionary hostile targeting, professional task or indefinite resource production. Reprogramming takes ten real active minutes and does not refresh its service block. An hour of work pays TI-05's six blocks, not six free encounters. Loss of communication permits only its already legal finite noncombat sequence; no new target choice or attack. A controller may give one wholly noncombat task start with an Action; the same capacities and actual power limits apply.
TI-04.verdictHeading: ## TI-04 — Control, binding, orders and finite active count

TI-05.title: Source N encounters and NEW out-of-combat accounting
TI-05.text:
For each18 ordinary automaton, `serviceRemaining` starts at its printed N. First actual operation in a genuine encounter spends one unit, covering only that encounter and at most **ten elapsed minutes**. If the encounter genuinely exceeds ten minutes, another unit funds the next block without declaring a new encounter or refreshing class uses. Leaving/reentering that same encounter inside its paid block does not spend or grant another unit; starting a distinct genuine encounter does spend another. No benefit from attacking allies, helpless captives or harmless animals to manufacture encounter boundaries.

Outside encounters, first operation opens one **ten-elapsed-minute** block and spends one unit. A pause/shutdown/suppression does not refund or extend that block. Entering a genuine encounter closes an earlier noncombat block and spends a new encounter unit. Ordinary idleness before a block starts spends nothing and grants no active behavior. At zero with no remaining paid block, the creature is inert and grants no movement/Dodge/task/attack until real service; a balance of zero during a paid block does not shorten that legitimately paid block. Blocks remain tied to physical identity across transfer, rest, damage, repair and initiative changes.

These are NEW finite accounting completions of the printed encounter service life, not independent charge attacks within the paid encounter. An attack still requires its own normal command/offense allowance every round. Short/long rest, dawn, Field Repair, Snap Rebuild and returning from meld restore no service unit.686 has its distinct winding profile; it does not inherit N from a similarly named automaton.
