No benefit from attacking allies, helpless captives or harmless animals to manufacture encounter boundaries.

Outside encounters, first operation opens one **ten-elapsed-minute** block and spends one unit. A pause/shutdown/suppression does not refund or extend that block. Entering a genuine encounter closes an earlier noncombat block and spends a new encounter unit. Ordinary idleness before a block starts spends nothing and grants no active behavior. At zero with no remaining paid block, the creature is inert and grants no movement/Dodge/task/attack until real service; a balance of zero during a paid block does not shorten that legitimately paid block. Blocks remain tied to physical identity across transfer, rest, damage, repair and initiative changes.

These are NEW finite accounting completions of the printed encounter service life, not independent charge attacks within the paid encounter. An attack still requires its own normal command/offense allowance every round. Short/long rest, dawn, Field Repair, Snap Rebuild and returning from meld restore no service unit.686 has its distinct winding profile; it does not inherit N from a similarly named automaton.

**AEX-03 — controlling clarification:** First actual operation of this automaton in a genuine encounter spends one service unit and opens that encounter's paid operating block, lasting at most ten elapsed minutes from that operation. Mere encounter start does not debit a stored or otherwise unoperated automaton. Ordinary idleness before a block starts spends nothing and grants no active behavior. Continuing operation beyond a block's expiry needs another paid block; a distinct genuine encounter has its own service requirement. Preserve TI-05's transition from an operating noncombat block into a genuine encounter, its no-refund/no-clock-pause rules and its physical-identity history.

TI-06.title: Twelve utility profiles and actual servicing
TI-06.text:
**Utility IDs:**591,595,597,602–604,606,614,617,621,623,685. Keep printed bonus and C. A capable lead must personally use the exact device in a necessary physical step of one real Engineering, Investigation or tool check, for **at least one active minute or the whole explicitly shorter task**, then keep it complete, accessible, unsuppressed and participating at resolution. A contact sensor reaches only actual exposed material within its physical working reach; it is not a scan through doors or a general detector.

Declare one qualifying utility source and spend its one charge **before the roll**. No after-failure addition, assistant possession bonus or extra PB. Apply AC-07's existing task-enhancement comparison with other actually eligible equipment. If another value is stronger, the declared spent source does not refund its charge. Its +B affects that one check, not the entire scene or every participant.

**NEW scope restriction against self-production loops:** no TI utility bonus on producing, repairing, re-encoding, charging or servicing any bonus-granting advanced/gathering item, including another utility device; no help on the operation that restores this budget. A genuinely different ordinary Engineering/Investigation/tool task, ordinary mechanism diagnosis/disabling, ordinary non-bonus equipment craft, or genuinely relevant information/formula research can qualify where the physical device actually contributes. Never convert “tool check” into every spell, save, research check or remote action. This explicitly bounds the source's otherwise broad check phrase; it does not erase actual credentials or grant formulas.

**NEW servicing applies to the11 traps,12 utilities and18 ordinary automata only:** one trained INT/Tinker's-tools task at **DC10**, **one active hour**, actual toolkit/drivers/gauge and stable safe work surface, with a real model-matched **maintenance pack** priced at10% of that admitted mundane body reference and weighing `max(0.01lb,0.01×body empty lb)` rounded up to0.01lb. One pack contains finite ordinary replacement contact/packing/fastening material for one service, not a rare source core or recoverable source ingredient. Require an actual supplied compatible pack; a gp entry is not physical stock. The reference is an authored baseline, not infinite market availability.

Service requires a complete functional positive-HP body and safe actual access. Success sets its service/charge budget to source maximum once; failure consumes the pack/time and gives no refill. Use Core task natural shifts collapsed to binary, no quality/critical extra, catalyst, XP or Forge Dwarf discount. Service may be performed at an actually suitable field surface even though **creation** has fieldCraftable=false; actual hazards can still prevent it. It restores no HP/flaw, repairs no missing primary and does not restart an active block, timed class effect, mark, original deployment or round budget. End an active operation safely before service. Repeating successful service at full balance produces no surplus. This is not rest; a working hour cannot also be the same beneficial resting hour.
TI-06.verdictHeading: ## TI-06 — Twelve utility profiles and actual servicing

TI-07.title: Creature versus object, conditions and recovery
TI-07.text:
**NEW classification:** the18 ordinary automata and686 are **Construct creatures with one printed HP track**, not objects while favorable and creatures while attacking. At0 they are destroyed/inert recoverable wrecks, not dying, Stable, unconscious or candidates for death saves/Wounds. No disappearance or free material is inferred; keep actual physical remains and original primary membership. Ordinary biological healing and rest do not restore them; explicitly device/construct-compatible repair/healing class sources can restore functional machines within their real scopes. Snap Rebuild is the exact exceptional0HP route addressed in TD-07; ordinary AC-09 reconstruction is available with intact originals and actual costs.

**NEW defense completion:** these19 nonbiological chassis are immune to poison damage and Poisoned; no psychic-damage, Charmed, Frightened, elemental or source-tag immunity is added. A condition can apply only when its actual source admits the creature and its mechanics have a real applicable effect. They require no food, breath or beneficial biological sleep, but this supplies neither stasis nor free source resources. Suppression makes their powered behavior inert without changing their source HP/AC or ticking service/duration history. Actual wounds/cargo inherited from another creature are not manufactured.

Their body joints are not cheap separately-targetable5HP objects. Source AC/HP govern creature attacks and permitted effects; only a genuinely predeclared separable component has separate targeting. Traps/utilities/687 are structural objects with object immunities and their actual Sunder rules, not creature saving throws or death saves. An idle object trap does not grow creature actions.

All are magical crafted outputs. Wrecked/suppressed advanced machines are not automatically mundane dismantling targets. General creature-remains harvest or a magical-item salvage profile must actually authorize the selected route first, and the same matter cannot be claimed again through the other route. Consumed class debris/recycling and terminal dismantling prevent reconstruction of that same body; legitimate surviving claimed components can enter only real later manufacture with continuing lineage.
TI-07.verdictHeading: ## TI-07 — Creature versus object, conditions and recovery

TI-08.title: Custom686, three-target coordination without hostile command
TI-08.text:
KEEP **Small,AC18,HP80,three targets,120ft and the literal Silent Ones/Heartcell prohibition**. NEW body TI-drone has walk25ft, STR12,DEX10,CON12,INT6,WIS10,CHA1, ordinary sight/hearing, passivePerception10, no flight/telepathy/attack or Anacite stats. Its relative intelligence is a limited protocol processor, not an assertion about a soul or sentience. It can convey observed ordinary status, not hidden state or remote inventories.

**NEW power:** one minute of actual manual winding with both hands powers at most one elapsed hour; capped at one hour remaining. Rewinding requires stopping the drone and actual access, never banks hours. Suppression/pause does not stop that elapsed deadline. This is its own winding clock, not a source charges field, dawn recharge or restoration. A complete positive-HP chassis is required. Power alone authorizes no command or offense.

Register its capable controller under TI-04. During ten active minutes, link at most three actual consenting/authorized existing Constructs or dungeon mechanisms, each with an actual protocol, current controller/owner permission, physically compatible interface and lawful action profile. No hostile control check is supplied; unknown/hostile/forbidden links fail admission rather than being overcome by a high roll. Replace a link only after explicit release and the same real setup. A fourth cannot act by briefly joining an oversized list. Silent Ones and Heartcell systems are never eligible under this item, even with a purported permission flag; preserve those literal identifiers without deciding their taxonomy.

The controller may use their one normal Bonus Action command to send a directly coordinated instruction through686 to a linked target **within120ft of the drone with line of effect**. Controller-to-drone communication must itself satisfy TI-04's60ft actual channel. One hop only. Up to three linked targets may receive status/task selection information, but **only one commanded action** executes through that owner's shared allowance; the others gain no action, attack or offensive movement. Another independently controlling creature must pay its own actual commands/actions for its own target. Class drones retain their class-specific command range/eligibility and no new class module/cap from the relay.686's range supplies no exception to a target mechanism's own restricted control source.

Loss of link/range/power before execution fails that command without refund; restored contact grants only later ordinary commands. No shared save/DC improvement, RP transfer, battlefield turn, automatic turret shot, forced consent or permission to operate a mechanism whose actual procedure remains unknown is supplied.
TI-08.verdictHeading: ## TI-08 — Custom686, three-target coordination without hostile command

TI-09.title: Custom687, manual ram and distinct magical breach
TI-09.text:
KEEP portable siege body, **12d10 force** against the printed doors/gates/barriers/Constructs, and one magical-breach attempt per long rest using **the crafter's Engineering bonus**. NEW TI-ram body:80lb,100gp mundane reference,48×18×18in,steelAC19/structuralHP20, captive head/frame/screw. It has no movement mode, passenger space, free ammunition, independent turn, class turret identity or autonomous action. Actual strength/carrying/support and a clear5ft working approach are required. Mounting/unmounting takes five active minutes each with two hands on a sound surface; no free placement inside a closed passage.

**NEW normal attack:** one capable operator, both hands. Spend a **wind Action**, then an **align Action**, then a **discharge Action on three distinct successive-or-later own regular turns**. Alignment names one actually perceived legal target within5ft and line of effect; preserve that target/position until discharge. No helper/extra turn/Extra Attack/Gadget Sync shortens the cycle. An actual necessary delay retains a safe wound stage, but moving, changing operator or changing target cancels alignment and requires restarting the cycle; no stored unlimited attacks. Outside initiative the minimum three-action cycle is18 elapsed seconds of work. The actual physical mechanism is hand-powered; its source magic supplies the printed force event, not external power generation.

At discharge make a **NEW fixed+6 melee siege-item attack** against that target's actual creature/material/worn-target AC. Hit12d10force, no flat ability damage, natural1 miss/natural20 doubles attack dice. It cannot attack ordinary non-Construct creatures merely by calling them barriers. Objects retain actual compatibility/immunity/unbreakable source rules. It supplies no automatic destruction, Wound exception, area damage, forward movement or follow-through target. It is a direct operator Action, not a companion's commanded attack. The next strike needs a new complete cycle.

**NEW magical breach mode replaces that discharge, not an additional12d10 attack.** At the legal attempt, debit this physical ram's one long-rest entitlement. The acting user need not be the crafter but must follow the cycle and have a genuinely eligible magically sealed passage. Snapshot at original completion the crafter's **unbuffed INT plus actual Engineering PB/replacing expertise and any independently reviewed permanent non-item Engineering modifier**; no creation specialty, assistant, facility, temporary buff, utility item, borrowed class level or later buyer statistic. No Engineering proficiency means no Engineering PB. Preserve the actual contributing source records; a price or new creator ID does not fabricate the statistic.

Use that fixed modifier on one Core Engineering task collapsed to binary. The passage's actual eligible breach DC takes precedence; otherwise **NEW defaultDC28** for an ordinary nonunique magical passage seal that has no contrary immunity or special key-only rule. Unknown/unique/explicitly unbreachable systems require their actual profile, not an automatic favorable default. Failure spends the attempt with no opening. Success opens one at-most5ft passage in that local magical obstruction for **one elapsed minute**; it does not destroy a physical door, disable the entire installation or reveal protected lore. A physical door remains subject to actual ordinary breach/damage. The returning magical obstruction blocks new crossings at expiry and grants no cutting/crushing damage or automatic displacement to a creature already in the act of crossing. Actual more-specific seal behavior wins where independently provided. This is a new bounded local breach, not general Dispel Magic or permission concerning Silent Ones/Heartcell systems.

**NEW rest binding:** record one registered operator and this physical ram's spent entitlement. A refill requires that registered operator to complete a genuine beneficial eight-hour long rest, wholly after the last expenditure, with the ram present/accessible throughout. A legitimate change of operator takes ten active minutes with lawful custody and preserves the spent state; the new operator must then complete their own qualifying post-expenditure rest with this ram. Prior rest, an already rested buyer, the maker resting elsewhere, an extra resting assistant, repair or a second name supplies no refill. Only one ram refill event is recorded for that qualifying rest; simultaneous people cannot bank several. This permits ordinary transfer, including after an operator dies, without an immediate fresh breach. It adds no RP pool or effect from an unbeneficial rest. Ordinary wind/align/discharge and HP repair have no long-rest refresh dependency.
TI-09.verdictHeading: ## TI-09 — Custom687, manual ram and distinct magical breach

TI-10.title: 623's one year and exact consumed tooling
TI-10.text:
**623:** KEEP source `craftingTime:"1 year"`, `activeWorkHours:null`, `laborValue:0`, special mode, false field flag, DC25, level20/tier10, Q1, assistant cap3 and trivial20. The current crafting framework already supplies **1,920 active hours per workyear**; operational minutes are115,200. Eligible Forge Dwarf uses **1,440 hours/86,400 minutes**. This is an operational time overlay, not changing the original null or claiming the preserved zero labor represented a realistic wage. With the included15-minute phase, remaining work is1,919.75 or1,439.75 hours. Secure special/legacy access, actual work Watches, assistants and source materials still apply; no calendar-year idle completion or1,920.25-hour double charge.

Its TI-tool body adds10gp/3lb, so default finished reference is **350,098+10=350,108gp**, not a rebuilt price from a new labor assumption. Its six utility charges use TI-06; source title grants no sentience or psychic detection.

Preserve **685[2]200gp/1lb Control mechanism,686[2]18,000gp/1lb Control mechanism,687[4]18,000gp/1lb Connecting rods**, all consumed tool-role occurrences. They do not pay for the separate Sensor/Drone/Ram bodies, survive as retained toolkit parts or receive catalyst retention. Keep 612's and the exceptional recipes' exact private source metadata; no new ritual/catalyst, Matrix research or cosmology decision follows.
TI-10.verdictHeading: ## TI-10 — 623's one year and exact consumed tooling

B-01.title: Enchanting carriers
B-01.text:
EN-weapon and EN-armor are existing actual complete mundane equipment, not new free gear. The table gives a Standard Medium longsword and chain shirt as default bindable models; the named current equipment records control their exact ordinary combat properties. No new attack or armor proficiency is granted. Exclude ammunition bundles, natural attacks, shields, creatures, already imprinted/magically altered hosts and unsupported special models from these host choices. A different admitted weapon/suit needs its full existing source profile and actual value/mass/structure registered before work. This is a finite host selection, not a new recipe or automatic all-gear fit permission.

Wand and Staff are continuous hardwood rods. Their fixed profile includes grip, inscriptions and protective finish in the stated mass, but no scabbard, hidden compartment, lens, battery, fuel or concentration focus. Charm/Sigil/Seal are solid or hollow-backed steel inscription faces with captive finger grip/loop; the original face is the magic-bearing primary, and a compatible minor grip/cord may be replaced. Focus comprises a 0.3-lb original optical body and 0.2-lb original inscribed rim; a support grip can be repaired, but a new lens is not the original magical lens. Other carriers have no additional part-valuations; total body value is not cloned onto each fragment.

Every pulse carrier requires one manipulating hand at activation. A neck-hung Charm can be carried in a lawful existing jewelry position, but its name supplies no passive benefit and it must actually be grasped to use Typed Pulse. EN Staff is too large to become a necklace or disappear into a small container by calling it a focus. Simultaneous held gear follows actual hands and ordinary access Actions.

B-02.title: Rune plates and custom seal
B-02.text:
RC-plate contains the inscription plate0.8lb plus captive feet/attachment strap0.2lb, total1lb. It supports no cargo. A strap can secure it in the one declared Rune-wearing position or on a real surface; attaching it does not convert that host into the rune's HP pool, manufacture armor, or allow the host to pay another output reserve. Feet/strap are replaceable subordinate parts; the inscription plate must survive for magical reconstruction.

RC-seal667 is a9.5-lb original stone tablet with0.5lb feet/support fittings, total10lb. Its width is not a20ft wall; the source radius is a magical field around that actual stationary tablet. Carrying, deployment and face clearance remain real. No load-bearing floor, doorway, room or permanent stone installation comes with either body. Unrecoverable inscription loss ends the original magic; payment alone cannot reproduce it.
B-02.verdictHeading: ## B-02 — Rune plates and custom seal

B-03.title: Scribing carriers
B-03.text:
SC-book binds the ordinary Book reference at25gp/5lb. NEW internal allocation: page block4lb, covers/binding1lb,200 writable pages. SC-text binds the ordinary1gp/1lb journal reference, with0.8lb original40-page block and0.2lb covers/binding. Each page is one side usable for authored text; no extra spell capacity arises from unused pages or writing smaller. A special formula, Lexicon or Codex uses this same finite carrier and its own one subject/payload/covenant allocation, not200 independent effects.

SC-sheet is one actual10×8-inch paper sheet at0.2gp/0.02lb/B1. SC-scroll is one actual12×8-inch parchment sheet at0.1gp/0.02lb/B1; no rod, protective case or complete book is included. Rolled size is determined by that physical sheet, not an extradimensional compartment. An independently supplied dry case adds its own weight/capacity and grants no magical preservation. Recipe673's consumed case is still a separate mandatory process input, not a retained case generated for every map.

Textual content, annotations, copied mundane information and a magical payload are separately recorded. The original magical page/sheet or relevant bound inscription block is primary. Missing vital pages, an erased payload or destroyed magical writing cannot be restored by replacing them with fresh blank paper under HP repair. A surviving damaged page can be repaired only where actual content/primary continuity makes that repair physically possible. Replaceable covers do not reset uses. Full page blocks/valid inscriptions must remain in the one bound item for its magical whole-book benefit; distributing pages does not distribute the bonus.

Ordinary consultation uses two manipulating hands while opening/turning pages unless an actual stable support holds the open book and permits a physically possible one-handed reading operation. A supported open book must be within5ft and readable; it does not follow a moving caster. Each spell still needs its own somatic/material hands. A caster unable to perform both reading and those components must alter the real arrangement rather than omit either requirement. There is no hands-free reading inside a closed bag.

B-05.title: Stations, ordinary kits and repair prerequisites
B-05.text:
KEEP actual complete primary kits and their original price/mass. A source-listed auxiliary already physically in that kit can fulfill that requirement, but ownership is not a duplicate item or an expensive recipe occurrence. The Runecarver working-optic completion is the narrow RC-09 kit binding. Enchanter's tools retain their stylus/ordinary focusing lens; Calligrapher supplies retain actual writing instruments; Tinker's tools need their actual precision drivers and calibration gauge. A selected output named Tool, Focus or Formula is not itself any of these complete kits.

NEW minimum physical worksite admission, not construction-cost additions: one active creator needs a stable clear working surface at least24×18in for carriers and appropriately sized actual jigs for the chosen complete weapon, suit or machine. Required Source Resonance Circle needs one clear5ft-square working bay and its actual ordinary focusing/stylus apparatus; this authorizes no magical energy source or new ritual. Slab must support the complete rune substrate; Scribe's Desk must allow actual open page preparation; Tinker's Workshop must safely support and fixture every currently worked assembly. For687, that means a clear60×30in sound work area supporting at least100lb of ram/work stock before crew loading. Record a real stronger station when actual load requires it. A portable sheet placed on a ledge does not become a stationary workshop.

No requirement makes all maximum-yield reserves occupy one overloaded bench simultaneously: use actual separate reserved storage and sequential work within the original hours. Hands, station capacity, light, safe access, preservative clocks and hazardous-material containment remain actual admission conditions. Ordinary table/station rental is not a catalyst supply, protected long-term vault or secret-work authorization.

All ordinary material defenses, object damage compatibility and carried-item targeting follow the actual equipment procedure. The whole-item B track is not duplicated onto each screw/page/limb. No unmodeled pin is an invented cheaper Sunder target. Repair quotations are material references, not physical replacement stock; record real supplies and their mass/disposition. Missing/burnt primary matter, irreversibly dismantled assemblies and already consumed debris fail reconstruction even if the full quotation is paid.
B-05.verdictHeading: ## B-05 — Stations, ordinary kits and repair prerequisites

TD-01.title: Identity and each class benefit
TD-01.text:
KEEP automatic Anacite ownership, its actual AC/HP/flight/bolt/Shock profile and its specific reconstruction/module routes. The 18 TI automata and686 are separate purchased/crafted Constructs; the other24 TI outputs are mechanical objects. None is an Anacite, class bomb, class turret, class Net Trap or class temporary deployable solely by a shared word. The complete 48-card eligibility register below identifies every card's reach. General device effects are expressly admitted only through the gates below; no Tinker level or selected card is awarded by ownership.

For general class-device effects, **NEW target binding** is a complete actual TI mechanical body or surviving recoverable original TI wreck, with the required current state. It does not automatically include EN weapons, Rune tablets, Scribing books, gathering implements or every magical item. Jury-rig's separate printed weapon target may admit an actual EN weapon on its own terms; that does not make it a Tinker device. Consumed process lenses, power cells and input Control mechanisms are not additional finished target devices.
TD-01.verdictHeading: ## TD-01 — Identity and each class benefit

TD-02.title: One command/offensive budget, not one per trade
TD-02.text:
KEEP the current lifecycle's owner-wide numbered-round command/offense ledger for actual companions, class drones/turrets/Scraplings and the TI-04 crafted companions. One ordinary Bonus Action command allows one attached move plus one attack or task by one eligible subject, not one by each controlled subject. TI traps explicitly reserve this same owner's offensive allowance when their automatic damaging entry discharge resolves, without inventing an extra Bonus Action. The manual687 ram instead uses the operator's three ordinary Actions under TI-09; it is not a commanded companion or turret.

A non-Tinker uses exactly the same crafted-controller procedure without receiving class RP, commands, slots or Anacite statistics. Multiple real actors retain their own actually controlled subjects and turn resources; ownership/permission cannot be rotated during an already committed round to give the same machine a second offensive action. Track both the owner's spent allowance and the actual subject's already-executed offensive event for that numbered round. A transfer inherits the subject's spent round, remaining service and pending commands; it is not an extra action source.
TD-02.verdictHeading: ## TD-02 — One command/offensive budget, not one per trade

TD-03.title: Caps and physical stock
TD-03.text: KEEP class Anacite cap1, or maximum2 under actual level13 Dual Drone Protocols, separately from class deployable slots1/2/3 at6/13/17. NEW TI controller limits remain three active ordinary craft automata plus at most one active686. Inert owned stock can be carried only with actual mass, space and custody; being outside the active cap is not a storage dimension. Crafted bodies do not consume or expand class slots. All active sets still share the command/offense limit. A controller change needs actual setup, lawful release/access and current history; no fourth active ordinary automaton or second active686 appears between bookkeeping steps.

TD-04.title: Eighteen attacks stay source-bound
TD-04.text: KEEP every source AC/HP, encounter-service count and damage type. Adopt the eighteen exact NEW melee profiles in TI-03 and the machine-readable register: `attackBonus=2+sourceServiceMaximum`, damage `sourceServiceMaximum d6` of the **printed attack's type**, reach5ft. Tiny/Small physical and ability/Speed distinctions are TI-03/B-04. Do not import Anacite's PB+INT,1d6 piercing,flight30,bolt Shock,poison/psychic/charm immunities or class-level scaling.686 has no basic attack;687 has its own operator+6/12d10force cycle, not a nineteenth ordinary automaton attack.

TD-05.title: Modules are actual Anacite hardware
TD-05.text: KEEP the nine engine modules and their actual choices, costs, slot schedule, long-rest replacement, command requirements and hard-denial guard. Burn Injector, Poison Vents, Concussive Bolt, Target Taunter, Energy Shield, Smoke Cloud, Ammo Dispenser, Target Scanner and Tether Grappler can be installed only in the actual class Anacite module slots. No TI body has an authored compatible module socket. A TI Psychic attack is not a class bolt;686 is not a module relay. Independent allies may receive a genuinely applicable class module's stated effect, but the recipient never acquires that module or a free commanded action.
TD-05.verdictHeading: ## TD-05 — Modules are actual Anacite hardware

TD-06.title: Mechanical Aptitude and bounded diagnosis/disable
TD-06.text:
KEEP advantage for an actually selected Mechanical Aptitude on a check whose declared task is **understanding, repairing or disabling an accessible mechanism with actual tools**. This can apply to AC-09 repair/reconstruction of a qualified TI machine and to the actual mechanical disarming of a TI trap. It does not bypass original-primary requirements or make an expired/consumed target reconstructible.

It does not automatically apply to all four trades' creation, Rune magical identification, spell research, book translation, servicing, mundane dismantling recovery or any INT roll. An independently necessary mechanism-understanding check may qualify without lending that advantage to the subsequent separate creation/service/salvage check. TI servicing is replenishment/calibration, not HP repair, and therefore does not itself receive Mechanical Aptitude advantage. Unrelated spell or class modifiers keep their actual separate scopes; neither PB nor a feat is granted.

Technical Knowledge can identify the accessible **ordinary mechanical purpose/control** of a visible nonartifact TI device with its printed INT+PB/DC15/Action/Recharge2. It cannot reveal its magical charge schedule, hidden spell, secret command password, private source dossier, authorizes-no-control system or safe active-core containment. A sound ordinary mechanical observation is not proof of magical function. Basic Rune inspection uses RC-02 rather than this card.

**NEW narrow object-save completion for Overload Suppression:** a TI creature uses its actual CON modifier; a TI mechanical object has CON+0 **only for this named class technique's required save**. This creates no general object ability array or blanket susceptibility to creature spells. On failure apply the source's lost-next-Reaction/attack disadvantage only where that target actually has those capabilities. On failure by5, its eligible physical operation is disabled by the source Stunned hard-denial effect, subject to current denial guard/immunity; no new allegiance, damage or permanent deactivation. For an object lacking a target turn, expiry is the end of its controller's next regular turn, or the caster's next regular turn when it has no controller; outside initiative use the corresponding fixed six-second boundary. Do not borrow an extra turn to shorten the denial. The source save and degree remain that class technique's own procedure, not basic dismantling's exception.
TD-06.verdictHeading: ## TD-06 — Mechanical Aptitude and bounded diagnosis/disable

TD-07.title: Functional repair versus real destruction
TD-07.text:
Field Repair can target a **functional, positive-HP damaged TI machine**, including an automaton, utility, trap,686 or687, using its printed Action/1RP/Recharge2 and S d8+M healing. It can clear the specifically routed-Dissonance disabled state of an otherwise functional positive-HP device even when no HP is missing. It cannot restoreHP0, missing primaries, elapsed duration, service units, traps/utility charges, Rune uses, script uses or687's breach entitlement. Repair Pulse and Restoration Field likewise affect eligible positive-HP TI targets only, preserving their actual source limits and costs.

The class engine's1RP/ten-minute/once-per-short-rest destroyed-Anacite repair and long-rest rebuild remain **Anacite only**. Other TI wrecks use AC-09 unless an actually acquired source such as Snap Rebuild explicitly applies. **NEW Snap Rebuild compatibility:** a surviving original TI wreck at0HP with every required recoverable primary can receive that card's own2RP/Bonus Action/once-per-encounter restoration to half maximum, rounded down, minimum1 only where half would otherwise be0 and the actual source maximum is positive. TI maxima here are all at least5, so no minimum changes a supplied TI result. Persistent original bodies have no expired summon duration; preserve their own class-independent controller slot and all service/charge history. Timed class devices retain their original slot/expiry and ineligibility after expiry. This is a named class exception to ordinary reconstruction time/material fees, not a new cheap general repair route. Terminal sacrifice, consumed recycling/debris and irreversibly dismantled items remain ineligible.
TD-07.verdictHeading: ## TD-07 — Functional repair versus real destruction

TD-08.title: Protected Dissonance routing
TD-08.text:
KEEP once per short rest, Bonus Action, up to two **current** Dissonance, one of that Tinker's actual active devices within30ft. Explicitly admit TI devices only when currently genuinely active: an armed charged trap; a powered automaton/686 in its paid/wound operating interval; a utility actually participating in a live eligible task; or an aligned ram in its live legal cycle. Merely carrying a cheap unused tool is not an active device. This is an eligibility definition, not a new Dissonance/RP conversion rate.

Routing disables movement, attack, aura, trigger and other active use while its duration/service clock continues. No RP appears and Refrain does not reset. Clear that specific disable through actual Field Repair where qualified, or the engine's ten active minutes/1RP/Tinker's tools route, or **the routing Tinker's next completed genuine short rest**. A buyer's unrelated rest does not clear another user's routed state. Normal HP restoration may clear it only after that actual repair completes; paying a quote or renaming a device does not. None refills uses. Transfer retains disable origin, expiry, resource record and current body. One short-rest allowance remains one regardless of the number or price of owned machines.
TD-08.controllingText:
KEEP once per short rest, Bonus Action, up to two **current** Dissonance, one of that Tinker's actual active devices within30ft. Explicitly admit TI devices only when currently genuinely active: an armed charged trap; a powered automaton/686 in its paid/wound operating interval; a utility actually participating in a live eligible task; or an aligned ram in its live legal cycle. Merely carrying a cheap unused tool is not an active device. This is an eligibility definition, not a new Dissonance/RP conversion rate.

A routed trap cannot discharge, and a routed utility cannot provide its charged task benefit while disabled. Existing durations and paid service/winding clocks continue. Clearing the disable requires its existing specifically authorized completed removal procedure; it does not refill charges, service, RP or Refrain, erase expenditures, or grant a queued activation.

TD-09.title: Jury-rig and source-specific comparisons
TD-09.text:
KEEP **Action**,1RP,Recharge3,touch willing ally weapon/device,three rounds,one modification per item. Do not convert its Action to a Bonus Action. NEW classification puts its+1 first-attack-per-turn option in `class.tinker-jury-rig`, one nonstacking modification. This genuine class bonus can add once to an independently eligible equipment accuracy bonus; it is not a second copy of EN's B, and no second Jury-rig stacks. Calibrated Precision/Target Scanner and Enhanced Drone Control/Enhanced Targeting keep their specifically stated comparisons; no universal strongest-only rule erases independent class benefits.

A TI attack profile can receive Jury-rig+1 when it actually makes a legal attack. A save-only trap,686 without an attack, or a utility receives no invented attack roll. Its+5ft movement option affects only an already existing actual Speed, so Tiny/Small/686 can benefit; ram or fixed trap gains no locomotion. Commands, service and concentration costs remain unchanged. A class buff does not add to687's fixed creator Engineering snapshot.

TD-10.title: Gadget Sync remains a turret shot
TD-10.text:
KEEP the actual paid source: after a class bomb throw,1RP,one actual eligible class turret within60ft,one ordinary shot at a surviving original bomb target. It consumes/replaces the owner's existing commanded offensive allowance for that numbered round, not an additional Bonus Action attack. Apply the current lifecycle window and subject-offense record; no extra-turn refresh.

**None of these43 TI recipes is a class turret with the required ordinary turret shot.** An automaton, damaging trap,686 or687 cannot receive Gadget Sync through its family name. Choosing a physical gun-like decoration does not supply that profile. Known class Sniper/Burst/Sentry and other actual authorized turret profiles retain their own source eligibility; no recipe gets converted into one.
TD-10.verdictHeading: ## TD-10 — Gadget Sync remains a turret shot

TD-11.title: Technical Mastery is one paid damage adjustment
TD-11.text:
KEEP the printed after-damage d10 trigger; only on10 may the Tinker spend1RP to add `floor(unmodified damage dice total/2)` to one target of that genuine own damaging device activation. No duplicate activation, command, charge, healing, resource, riders or secondary proc. NEW TI compatibility includes the eleven traps, eighteen automata and687 **only if the actual activation occurs within that card's own-turn window**. A delayed attached companion attack after the owner's whole turn is not retroactively the owner's turn. A trap discharging on another creature's turn similarly cannot bank a Technical Mastery trigger for later. Direct687 discharge on the Tinker's own regular turn can qualify; its magical-breach check is not a damage activation.

Calculate from the original attack's unmodified damage dice, not critical multiplication, bonus dice from Overcharge/Volatile Injection, flat modifiers, a prior Technical Mastery addition, mitigated damage or multiple target totals. For these single-type TI attacks, the addition has that original type and joins that same target's one damage event before final defense/HP commitment. A trap target that succeeds and therefore takes zero is not given new damage by this adjustment. Resolve only once with an eligible target; it neither resurrects a removed target nor redirects to a new one. Siege Savant remains pending and supplies no multiplier in this conference.
TD-11.verdictHeading: ## TD-11 — Technical Mastery is one paid damage adjustment

TD-12.title: Service, restoration and rest clocks
TD-12.text: KEEP TI-05/06's N encounters/ten-minute blocks, one-hour servicing with actual maintenance pack and its check, and bounded refilling to printed maximum. HP repair, Field Repair, Repair Pulse, class Anacite rebuild, short rest, dawn, turning off, transfer, stowage and suppression do not service a crafted machine.686 has manual winding instead;687 has hand-wound actions plus its separately defined breach long-rest event. Repair can make a body functional without supplying any remaining paid operating interval. Conversely, servicing a damaged positive-HP body refills its service allowance without healing it. A Broken body needs restoration first, then servicing if its budget is empty.
TD-12.verdictHeading: ## TD-12 — Service, restoration and rest clocks

TD-13.title: Recycling refunds actual deployment RP only
TD-13.text: KEEP actual enemy destruction, your own device, one minute after combat, once per short rest, consume its usable debris and return at most1RP actually paid to **deploy that same device**. Crafting GP, ingredients, dawn charges, service packs, encoding, field repairs, Dissonance routing and later Overcharge RP are not deployment RP. These43 crafted devices have no innate RP deployment cost, so they create **zero refundable deployment RP** through this card. Do not consume a valuable wreck merely by falsely asserting that its price is RP; admission must identify an actual eligible prior paid deployment. Deliberate sacrifice, copied objects and repeated debris claims do not qualify. No unspecified material salvage percentage is added by the class's legacy name.
TD-13.verdictHeading: ## TD-13 — Recycling refunds actual deployment RP only

TD-14.title: One debris history, exclusive consumption
TD-14.text:
Before Recycling, Scrap Salvage, Scrap Reaper, Snap Rebuild or any independently authorized salvage, reserve the actual surviving debris membership and one route. An already consumed/terminal body cannot pay another route. Enemy-destroyed genuine TI debris may satisfy a source-qualified Scrap Salvage/Scrap Reaper input if it passes immutable-origin, enemy-destruction, access and class cost/slot rules; this is those **specific class conversions**, not a mundane magical-item salvage profile. Consume the reserved debris into that one temporary class result, retaining ancestry; it cannot rebuild the old machine, pay a recipe or produce another replacement when the temporary result ends.

Remote Detonation and Catastrophic Overload are explicitly deliberate terminal sacrifices. Where the actual class owner has those cards, the NEW general-device binding admits their own complete actual TI body as the sacrifice, but ends its original functioning body before the blast and consumes its operative primary assembly. No fabricated fresh wreck, salvage value, Recycling refund, Snap Rebuild, secondary Volatile Components or Scrap Reaper chain follows. Preserve any actual harmless residue as uncredited residual matter rather than deleting physical mass. Ordinary enemy destruction without a consuming effect leaves only its real recoverable wreck and no implied material award.
TD-14.verdictHeading: ## TD-14 — One debris history, exclusive consumption

TD-15.title: Temporary class tools and real creation phases
TD-15.text:
KEEP Field Fabrication and Improvised Engineering as temporary ordinary implements with their original costs, duration, scope and no cash value. A genuinely compatible created ordinary implement can serve a retained auxiliary function during work **only while it actually exists and its source permits that use**. It cannot satisfy a tiered named source occurrence simply by price/name, a complete supplemental output-body reserve, a consumed permanent ingredient or a returned catalyst.

Record creation origin, actual expiry, position/mass and every credited phase. If it expires midphase, work pauses and loses that unfinished phase under the ordinary interruption rule; completed physical progress is not erased but no missing tool is retrospectively supplied. Repeated legitimate temporary creations have their own class limits and costs; no permanent toolset/commodity accumulates from their disappearance. A stationary workshop, real protective containment or an irreplaceable magical inscription is not “equivalent ordinary tool” stock.
TD-15.verdictHeading: ## TD-15 — Temporary class tools and real creation phases

TD-16.title: Overdrive is not servicing or permanent transformation
TD-16.text: KEEP source Mech Overdrive's existing capstone acquisition, once/long-rest expenditure, original deployment costs/slots, encounter-end maximum one-minute duration and no healing-pulse/charge reset. These43 recipe bodies are already persistent, so **none gains a useful body-duration extension or budget refresh** from it. It cannot extend TI's encounter-service block, Rune activation, script spell duration,675 covenant,667 ward,686 wound hour or687 breach. An independently eligible newly deployed timed class device remains its own source profile; no global reaction/cost or class unlock is supplied.
TD-16.verdictHeading: ## TD-16 — Overdrive is not servicing or permanent transformation

TD-17.title: 686 only coordinates genuine existing authority
TD-17.text: KEEP TI-08's one actual controller, three preauthorized linked targets,120ft target radius, actual controller-to-drone channel, one-hop relay and shared command/offense limit. It conveys a permitted instruction, not a controller's ownership, class level, module or attunement. A hostile target cannot be compelled, another controller's subject cannot be silently reassigned, and Silent Ones/Heartcell systems remain literally excluded. Unknown protocols/permissions remain unavailable, not pending generic hacking rules. Three link slots supply no extra three turns.
TD-17.verdictHeading: ## TD-17 — 686 only coordinates genuine existing authority

TD-18.title: Separate creation routes and pending feats
TD-18.text:
KEEP class bombs/deployables/temporary tools, permanent TI recipes and pending feats as separate grant and material systems. Known class bombs have their actual RP/stock/encounter rules and no permanent resale stock. A priced crafted Trap does not gain those bomb riders, Safe Detonation, Throw range or bomb-stock refill. A permanent body cannot be manufactured from an expired temporary source or from a suppressed magical host merely by calling it mundane.

All24 crafting-interface feat records, all25 Skill feat records and13 counterpart records remain preserved for their own focused reviews. No new feat becomes usable here. This includes the prospective copying/creation discounts, Runic Scholar, Spell Scribe, crafting specializations, Tinker Adept, Trapsetter and Siege Savant. Their original names/text are comparisons, not alternative authorization for free permanent bodies, extra commands, Rune recharge, language Insight, recipe knowledge, charge refill or material acquisition. Already reviewed feat/class grants retain only their actual prior approved scopes. No other feat is silently rejected or overwritten merely because these recipe defaults choose a different rule.

### Complete 48-card interface register

The independent file `TINKER_48_INTERFACE_REGISTER.json` preserves every full current class card beside its explicit eligibility decision. `TINKER_48_INTERFACE_REGISTER.md` lists every exact card ID. Both are part of this verdict. “Class-only” denies only an unprovided crafted-device conversion; it does not remove the class's actual grant. “Recipient” does not turn an allied construct into the effect's source. None of these rows promotes its provisional class card.
TD-18.verdictHeading: ## TD-18 — Separate creation routes and pending feats

W-01.title: Charged armor needs actual armor bodies
W-01.text:
Recipe121 is source Q4, source batch159gp, four active hours, DC8 and a one-charge+1/cold Enchanted Armor result. W-03.title: Dawn is a single clock event
W-03.text:
A valid EN object with maximumC3 spends its final charge at05:59 and is complete,positive-HP and unsuppressed at the fixed06:00 campaign dawn; it returns to3 once. Traveling into another local sunrise or changing owners does not refill it again. If suppressed at that06:00 event, record the missed eligible refill; unsuppressing at06:01 does not catch up. Actual next dawn may refill it if qualified then. Stowage/legitimate meld admits only EN-06's internal recharge clock exception, not use through a bag or new slots.

A Rune withC3 that has spent all three, a two-use script with zero uses and an automaton with zero service remain spent at06:00. Paying HP repair restores none of those budgets.
W-03.verdictHeading: ## W-03 — Dawn is a single clock event

W-04.title: Rune burst success is zero, not half
W-04.text:

A synthetic roll7 damages each affected creature that fails itsDC11 DEX save; successful savers take **zero**, not3. The setter/allies in range are not exempt. The burst spends its one charge once for all targets, leaves the body unarmed and creates no object damage/poison/secondary condition. A second simultaneous entrant is another potential burst target, not a second charge-trigger event. Standing in the square later produces no second entry.

For a multi-charge explosive Rune, movement/pickup disarms it; its next genuine discharge needs remaining charge, legal cleared-square rearming/delay and the item round guard. Dawn/repair never restores charge.
W-04.verdictHeading: ## W-04 — Rune burst success is zero, not half

W-05.title: Binding and healing keep separate semantics
W-05.text:
A creature fails recipe396'sDC9 STR save and becomes Restrained within the one-minute maximum. It may make the new end-regular-turn repeat save or spend an Action on the specified escape check; moving it entirely out of the bound square or moving/suppressing the original plate ends this particular local restraint. No failure-by5 Stun or extra creature target is added. A different valid restraint has its own remaining state; ending one does not erase all restraints.

A designated living ally at0HP may receive recipe399's1d8+2 healing through its actual healing eligibility. Direct helper touch requires the separate explicit RC-06 contact Action and never sweeps healing along the plate's path. A destroyed684 or a Dead creature receives no reconstruction/resurrection. A full-HP eligible ally can waste a legitimately committed charge; immunity/prevention likewise does not refund it. Grave/Unholy changes none of this.
W-05.verdictHeading: ## W-05 — Binding and healing keep separate semantics

W-06.title: Ward timing and a spent Reaction
W-06.text:
A bearer with an attuned ward must spend Reaction/charge **before** the triggering attack roll or save roll, not after seeing that they failed. Its B applies to that original attack/save as well as subsequent eligible events through the marked next regular-start boundary. A save-only event can trigger it. No second Reaction or second attuned ward appears before the bearer's first turn. Extra turns do not reset Reaction or advance the named regular-start expiry.

A source ward+2 and eligible jewelry+1 to a saving throw give the strongest eligible+2 in their defined family, not+3. An independent class feature retains its own legitimate comparison; wearing another irrelevant suit does not supply a Rune bonus. Suppression suspends the remaining ward benefit while the original deadline continues.
W-06.verdictHeading: ## W-06 — Ward timing and a spent Reaction

W-07.title: Current Rune lens is not a free ingredient
W-07.text:
Recipe399[1]'s current name `Resonance Lens` and historical `Focusing Crystal` denote the exact preserved consumed occurrence. A corresponding older-named lot qualifies only if its complete source identity/tier/form/quantity and physical lineage actually match. The included ordinary0.25-lb Runecarver optic is a working implement, not that0.1-lb consumed ingredient. One cannot return the consumed component as the retained toolkit or purchase a2gp ordinary optic to waive an expensive named source lot.

For a recipe outside the eight listed component correspondences, the alias is not automatically available. Preserve all other consumed Focusing Crystal names unchanged and keep all21 current working-tool phrases visible alongside their historical provenance.
W-07.verdictHeading: ## W-07 — Current Rune lens is not a free ingredient

W-08.title: One-year623 does not acquire a hidden new labor price
W-08.text:
Recipe623's source hours remain null and source laborValue remains0. Its governing one-year conversion is1,920 active hours, or1,440 for an actually eligible Forge Dwarf. The included first phase leaves1,919.75/1,439.75 hours, not an extra15-minute surcharge. Its source batch350,098gp plus TI-tool10gp gives **350,108gp** finished reference. A buyer's price, a new labor forecast or source rarity does not regenerate that preserved value.

It still has the literal six+3 utility uses and needs the separately authored service procedure after spending them. Its1hour functional repair or8hour ordinary-max Broken reconstruction is restoration, not another year of manufacture and not recharge. Broken reference is87,527gp with original primaries; the quotation does not establish those primaries.
W-08.verdictHeading: ## W-08 — One-year623 does not acquire a hidden new labor price

W-09.title: Rank8 capacity is not a noncaster spell grant
W-09.text:
Recipe505 carries one authentic spell/ritual of rank at most8, with **two** lifetime cast starts. Loading an actual rank8 payload takes eight active encoding hours, eight sp/0.08lb of new compatible encoding supplies and the DC18 check. The script has no payload until genuine successful encoding; blank purchase does not supply an unfinished spell effect.

A noncaster, wrong-class reader, under-level caster or caster missing RP/components cannot begin a cast and spends no use. A properly qualified caster uses the new one-activation temporary repertoire exception, pays the actual rank8 RP cost plus current surcharges and required materials, performs the actual spell's casting time/components and records its normal cadence. A legitimate Counterspell can leave one script use remaining with the paid cast expended. The second use is the same stored spell, not permission to reload another. Repairing the page afterward does not restore either use. This fixture cannot demonstrate the effect of an unidentified unfinished rank8 spell; that payload must be an actual completed record.
W-09.verdictHeading: ## W-09 — Rank8 capacity is not a noncaster spell grant

W-10.title: One failed map check, one expedition record
W-10.text:
Two researchers share one eligible recipe497 map. The first related failed check spends that physical map's one reroll for the actual expedition before failure consequences commit; reroll the original die selection with its original DC/modifiers and native natural-result rules, accepting the replacement result. The other researcher cannot reroll another failure using the same map merely by borrowing it. An unrelated fictional area on the map grants neither bonus nor reroll.

A brief Haven stop does not reset the map. Only the actual prior expedition's formal closure and a genuine newly authorized expedition record supplies the next per-expedition entitlement. Another independent correctly made map has its own item budget but cannot reroll the same check again through equipment-reroll chaining.
W-10.verdictHeading: ## W-10 — One failed map check, one expedition record

W-11.title: Finite Language Insight and hidden content
W-11.text:
A researcher who genuinely understands674's bridging text spends one hour studying its supported target language and gains its three Language Insight once for that underlying evidence. They may spend those3 plus eight active study hours toward a predeclared supported passage of at most250words, under SC-08. It does not grant the whole language or the correct answer to unknown encrypted cosmological content.

Photographing, copying, repairing, rebuying or remanufacturing that same evidence gives that researcher no fresh three-point award. A different genuine reader can study the actual same evidence for their own nontransferable record. A saturated six-point Insight balance does not bank overflow. Text with languages:0 remains zero; a nominal ancient title supplies no parallel text.
W-11.verdictHeading: ## W-11 — Finite Language Insight and hidden content

W-12.title: 675's first breach, consent and damage prevention
W-12.text:
Three actually willing capable parties sign one feasible ten-day agreement with two objective clauses, a defined evidence standard and physically possible mark sites. This spends the Codex's one covenant on final signature. A later proven voluntary breach by one signatory spends **that signatory's one**6d10psychic/mark event. A second breach of either clause by the same signer creates no second event. Another signatory has their own one-event limit, within the original maximum6 parties.

An actual psychic immunity can prevent the damage but does not refund the event or make the agreed visible30-day mark a damage immunity effect. The mark does not track, compel, lower saves or assign the generic Marked condition. An ambiguous, coerced or impossible bargain fails admission; a high roll cannot manufacture consent or authoritative hidden facts. Breaking/suppressing the Codex suspends future enforcement while deadlines run; missed historical events are not queued for punishment after repair. Existing marks follow their original removal/expiry rules.

The hidden annotation is only the actual recorded annotation and its authorized audience. The NEW high-level threshold is **character level11 or higher plus proficiency in at least three of the five listed research disciplines**, with actual one-hour qualified examination and accessible text. A numerical level does not create an absent annotation, publish a private dossier or interpret Matrix lore.
W-12.verdictHeading: ## W-12 —675's first breach, consent and damage prevention

W-13.title: 684's source HP and three services
W-13.text:
Choose Small before recipe684 creation: a real50gp/25lb unmodified B5 chassis. Its source body after completion isAC14/40HP,3 service units, the NEW+5 melee/3d6force attack, walk25ft and its fixed Small abilities. A valid3/5 chassis finishes at **24/40HP**, not full40 and not the Tiny profile. Full-chassis source HP does not scale with a level20 buyer. Tiny instead costs25gp/8lb and walks20ft while retaining the printedAC14/40HP and same basic attack.

One genuine fight opens a paid block and changes3→2; a later ten-minute noncombat task spends2→1; another genuine fight spends1→0. The machine may complete that already paid block, but it is inert after expiry until serviced. Rest, field HP repair and controller transfer do not change0. Successful service takes one hour, actual trained tools and a Small-chassis5gp/0.25lb pack, restoring3 without healing24HP. No class-drone long-rest rebuild supplies those services.
W-13.verdictHeading: ## W-13 —684's source HP and three services

W-14.title: Shared command cannot become five attacks
W-14.text:
A Tinker has one actual Anacite, a class Sentry, two active crafted automata and686 linking three authorized targets. They still have one ordinary Bonus Action command and one relevant offensive allowance in that numbered round. Choosing one automaton's attack leaves the others with only their lawful uncommanded behavior.686's three links do not grant three shots; the Sentry cannot fire through Gadget Sync unless its actual class bomb/payment/window and remaining shared allowance qualify. The same automaton cannot attack again after a controller swap.

A crafted damaging trap resolving earlier in the round may already have consumed that owner's offensive allowance. The next attempted companion attack then lacks that allowance; it is not an extra “different trade” action.687 can still be manually operated only by paying its own separate direct three-Action cycle; naming it a turret or handing its crank to a helper does not shorten that cycle.
W-14.verdictHeading: ## W-14 — Shared command cannot become five attacks

W-15.title: Utility, HP repair, service and temporary tools
W-15.text:
Recipe685 is a2lb/20gp Sensor body with source+2/three charges. It can assist an actual necessary exposed-mechanism Investigation/Engineering operation through its physical probe, not remotely detect a hidden enemy through a wall. It does not assist its own creation/repair/service or that of another bonus-granting advanced/gathering item.

At positiveHP and zero uses, Field Repair may restore genuinely missing HP but leaves zero uses. Successful TI servicing requires its own one-hour check and **2gp/0.02lb** maintenance pack and restores three uses without healing. A temporarily fabricated ordinary tool may support a genuinely compatible reusable phase before its one-hour expiry, but it cannot satisfy685's consumed200gp Control mechanism or the complete Sensor output reserve. Creating a new temporary tool does not turn the expired tool into a permanent input.
W-15.verdictHeading: ## W-15 — Utility, HP repair, service and temporary tools

W-16.title: 686 has links, not a fourth turn or forbidden access
W-16.text:
A Small686 isAC18/80HP with the separate manual-winding hour and no attack. An actual controller can establish up to three individually authorized compatible links. An owned Anacite can be among genuinely protocol-compatible links only with its actual class controller/cost/range conditions preserved; a hostile turret cannot be admitted by passing an invented INT check. A fourth target waits until one real link is released and the complete new setup is performed.

The120ft range is from the actual drone with line of effect; controller-to-drone60ft communication still must exist. Suppressing the relay prevents its commands and its hour keeps expiring. An alleged Silent Ones or Heartcell target is not admitted; no classification, hack or cosmological exception is invented from a permission flag.
W-16.verdictHeading: ## W-16 —686 has links, not a fourth turn or forbidden access

W-17.title: 687's source statistic is not the operator's best bonus
W-17.text:
At the ram's actual creation, a synthetic crafter has INT+4 and Engineering PB+3: the fixed ordinary creator Engineering term is+7. A later operator with+12 personal Engineering still uses **+7** for this ram's special breach, not+12 or its +6 normal attack. An actual eligible defaultDC28 magical passage requires the three-Action sequence and the ram's one breach entitlement. A numerical total27 fails before natural shifts; a natural20 yielding27 improves that failure one Core degree to Success. This is not an attack natural20 auto-critical nor basic dismantling's no-shift exception.

Success permits the bounded one-minute local magical opening without also inflicting12d10force or destroying a physical door. A failed attempt is spent. A freshly rested buyer receives no immediate recharge: after actual lawful ten-minute operator registration they must complete their own full qualifying post-expenditure beneficial eight-hour rest with this ram. Two simultaneous resting people cannot bank two breaches. Ordinary direct attacks keep requiring wind/align/discharge Actions and use actual+6 to hit.
W-17.verdictHeading: ## W-17 —687's source statistic is not the operator's best bonus

W-18.title: Technical Mastery adds damage, not another ram discharge
W-18.text:
A legal normal687 hit on its Tinker operator's own turn has an unmodified12d10 total60. On that owner's eligible d10=10 Technical Mastery trigger, spending1RP adds **30 force to that same target's damage event**, subject to defenses; it does not wind/fire again, double the entire attack, copy another target, activate a breach, consume another charge or trigger more mastery rolls. Pending Siege Savant supplies no multiplier.

A delayed crafted automaton attack after the owner's entire turn cannot backdate the source's own-turn trigger. An already succeeded-save trap dealing0 cannot add a new damage event through this feature. A Overcharge bonus die does not enlarge the unmodified base used for the half-dice calculation.
W-18.verdictHeading: ## W-18 — Technical Mastery adds damage, not another ram discharge

W-19.title: Exclusive wreck, repair and real return history
W-19.text:
An enemy destroys a genuinely owned ordinary TI automaton whose original primaries remain recoverable. AC-09 or an actually acquired eligible Snap Rebuild may restore that **same** wreck under its own cost/time; its empty service allowance stays empty. Efficient Recycling cannot return1RP from its GP construction price because deployment paid0RP. A separately eligible class Scrap Salvage conversion consumes that very debris; afterward it cannot also fund Snap Rebuild, a second Scrapling, new recipe inputs or mundane magical-item salvage.

A Masterwork-retained catalyst from any recipe is the same actual eligible unit with its continuing age and compatible vessel, not a second embedded core. A temporarily stabilized workpiece does not freeze the returned raw unit's past age. Ordinary unspent tools return only once. Two source occurrences sharing one catalog ID still require two actual quantities. HP repair, sale or new item labels erase none of these histories.
W-19.verdictHeading: ## W-19 — Exclusive wreck, repair and real return history

K-03.title: No remaining preliminary source question blocks ordinary authoring
K-03.text:
**All50 prepared AC/EN/RC/SC/TI questions and all18 TD cases have finite directions in this verdict.** The supplied originals are sufficient to build the exact167 operational candidates now. The files requested for this conference were accessible and inspected. Nothing here approves an unseen payload or candidate manuscript. The remaining genuine **execution dependencies**, not preliminary authoring blockers, are precisely: (1) an actual complete operational spell/ritual and its legitimate encoding/casting access; (2) actual named ingredients, host equipment, physical component bills and permitted acquisition/custody; (3) explicit safe handling of active/volatile/special materials and real stations/support; (4) actual target-specific permission/classification, including667's printed labels,686's control protocol/prohibitions and687's special seals; (5) actual authentic reference text, language evidence and675's willing participants/objective adjudication; (6) independently permitted special salvage, living/no-resource restrictions and future feat/class interactions not granted here. K-04.text:

There is no conditional exact-card promotion in this source conference.** No Tinker class-card or pending-feat promotion is granted. Counts stay520/687 and333/433public.

EN-weapon.operationalBodyText:
EN-weapon and EN-armor are existing actual complete mundane equipment, not new free gear. The table gives a Standard Medium longsword and chain shirt as default bindable models; the named current equipment records control their exact ordinary combat properties. No new attack or armor proficiency is granted. Exclude ammunition bundles, natural attacks, shields, creatures, already imprinted/magically altered hosts and unsupported special models from these host choices. A different admitted weapon/suit needs its full existing source profile and actual value/mass/structure registered before work. This is a finite host selection, not a new recipe or automatic all-gear fit permission.

Wand and Staff are continuous hardwood rods. Their fixed profile includes grip, inscriptions and protective finish in the stated mass, but no scabbard, hidden compartment, lens, battery, fuel or concentration focus. Charm/Sigil/Seal are solid or hollow-backed steel inscription faces with captive finger grip/loop; the original face is the magic-bearing primary, and a compatible minor grip/cord may be replaced. Focus comprises a 0.3-lb original optical body and 0.2-lb original inscribed rim; a support grip can be repaired, but a new lens is not the original magical lens. Other carriers have no additional part-valuations; total body value is not cloned onto each fragment.

Every pulse carrier requires one manipulating hand at activation. A neck-hung Charm can be carried in a lawful existing jewelry position, but its name supplies no passive benefit and it must actually be grasped to use Typed Pulse. EN Staff is too large to become a necklace or disappear into a small container by calling it a focus. Simultaneous held gear follows actual hands and ordinary access Actions.

SC-book.operationalBodyText:
SC-book binds the ordinary Book reference at25gp/5lb. NEW internal allocation: page block4lb, covers/binding1lb,200 writable pages. SC-text binds the ordinary1gp/1lb journal reference, with0.8lb original40-page block and0.2lb covers/binding. Each page is one side usable for authored text; no extra spell capacity arises from unused pages or writing smaller. A special formula, Lexicon or Codex uses this same finite carrier and its own one subject/payload/covenant allocation, not200 independent effects.

SC-sheet is one actual10×8-inch paper sheet at0.2gp/0.02lb/B1. SC-scroll is one actual12×8-inch parchment sheet at0.1gp/0.02lb/B1; no rod, protective case or complete book is included. Rolled size is determined by that physical sheet, not an extradimensional compartment. An independently supplied dry case adds its own weight/capacity and grants no magical preservation. Recipe673's consumed case is still a separate mandatory process input, not a retained case generated for every map.

Textual content, annotations, copied mundane information and a magical payload are separately recorded. The original magical page/sheet or relevant bound inscription block is primary. Missing vital pages, an erased payload or destroyed magical writing cannot be restored by replacing them with fresh blank paper under HP repair. A surviving damaged page can be repaired only where actual content/primary continuity makes that repair physically possible. Replaceable covers do not reset uses. Full page blocks/valid inscriptions must remain in the one bound item for its magical whole-book benefit; distributing pages does not distribute the bonus.

Ordinary consultation uses two manipulating hands while opening/turning pages unless an actual stable support holds the open book and permits a physically possible one-handed reading operation. A supported open book must be within5ft and readable; it does not follow a moving caster. Each spell still needs its own somatic/material hands. A caster unable to perform both reading and those components must alter the real arrangement rather than omit either requirement. There is no hands-free reading inside a closed bag.

TI-trap.operationalBodyText:
**TI-trap:** frame3lb, captive spring/actuation member2lb, original working striker/discharge block2lb, fittings/feet1lb; total8lb. No separately saleable ammunition or harvested elemental contents are created. Manual placement/arming and magic discharge use TI-02. The original 3-lb trigger frame and original 2-lb working striker/discharge block are primary and must survive in recoverable form. The 2-lb captive spring/actuation member and separate subordinate contacts, supports, catches, grip covers, fittings and feet may be replaced with actual compatible stock through the applicable restoration procedure. Contacts do not replace the primary discharge block. Preserve the same trap identity, original primaries, 12 × 12 × 3-inch envelope, 8-lb empty mass and 3/2/2/1-lb allocation. A missing/nonfunctional spring prevents discharge until repair is complete. Positive-HP repair uses DC10, max(1 hour, recorded maximumHP/10 hours) and 2.50 gp material reference; HP0 uses the original recipe DC, max(8 hours, maximumHP/10 hours) and 25% of the existing finished-unit reference. Actual trained Tinker's tools, INT, station, implements, compatible stock and completed work remain necessary. No spring replacement refills charges, services the trap, resets arming/command/offense/custody history, removes flaws or reverses terminal dismantling. Original-actuator requirements for automaton chassis and other bodies are unchanged. It is not an ordinary Hunting Trap weapon profile and does not add its conditions.

**TI-auto-tiny:** frame3lb, actuator2lb, logic/contact block1lb, legs/grippers/fittings2lb;8lb. **TI-auto-small:** frame10lb, actuator6lb, logic/contact block3lb, legs/grippers/fittings6lb;25lb. Each is a four-legged, ground-moving manual-clockwork chassis with two simple manipulators; neither can fly or become a climbing/swimming chassis by changing its name. Original frame, actuator and logic/contact block are primary. A replacement limb or fitting is subordinate only when its physical repair restores the same original machine, not a second chassis. No storage chamber is included.

NEW conservative handling caps: Tiny may carry at most5lb in its grippers, Small/686 at most20lb, also subject to the actual material shape, space, movement and current general Load restrictions. Carrying occupies the necessary manipulator and may make its one basic attack or task physically unavailable; it does not grant humanoid worn-equipment slots. These caps are not bonus harvest, automatic carriage of a creature, a passenger seat or a force multiplier. Unattended programmed carriage uses the actual paid operating block and finite route, never teleportation or implicit owner inventory.

**TI-tool:** manual driver/probe1.5lb, indexed mechanical gauge1lb, fitted handle/captive fittings0.5lb;3lb. Two hands operate the probe and stabilize actual work. **TI-device:** frame2lb, gauge1lb, manual calibration/contact mechanism1lb, grips/feet1lb;5lb. Its supported jaw space is4×4×2in, maximum2lb, on an actual stable bench. Both hands operate it. Its hollow shape is not a general cargo or safe fluid chamber. **TI-sensor685:** contact probe0.75lb, comparator1lb, handle/fittings0.25lb;2lb; both hands control probe/work. It compares actual exposed/reachable properties through its finite gauge, not remote creatures, hidden compartments, passwords, heat maps, souls or spell identification.

**TI-drone686:** frame10lb, relay/logic block5lb, manual winding/movement mechanism5lb, legs/controls5lb;25lb. Original frame and relay/logic block are primary; movement fittings still need actual compatible repairs. The wound mechanism and real communication limits are TI-08, not Anacite modules or a radio network granted by name. Two simple grippers provide ordinary constrained handling, not proficiency or automatic item activation.

**TI-ram687:** frame40lb, drive screw20lb, captive head15lb, grips/feet5lb;80lb. It does not fold smaller than its48×18×18in registered envelope or walk by itself. The required sound supporting surface must carry the ram plus actual crew/work loads. Original frame/screw/head are primary. Minor handles, feet and retaining fittings can be replaced but may not create a fresh charged ram or reset the original creator statistic. It has no fuel tank or recoverable force ammunition.

**AEX-05 — controlling clarification:** Hand-operated bench measuring/calibration box. An admitted workpiece must both fit the actual 4 × 4 × 2-inch jaw space and weigh no more than 2 lb. These are simultaneous limits, not alternatives. No general cargo space.

**TI-drone686:** frame10lb, relay/logic block5lb, manual winding/movement mechanism5lb, legs/controls5lb;25lb. Original frame and relay/logic block are primary; movement fittings still need actual compatible repairs. The wound mechanism and real communication limits are TI-08, not Anacite modules or a radio network granted by name. Two simple grippers provide ordinary constrained handling, not proficiency or automatic item activation.

**TI-ram687:** frame40lb, drive screw20lb, captive head15lb, grips/feet5lb;80lb. It does not fold smaller than its48×18×18in registered envelope or walk by itself. The required sound supporting surface must carry the ram plus actual crew/work loads. Original frame/screw/head are primary. Minor handles, feet and retaining fittings can be replaced but may not create a fresh charged ram or reset the original creator statistic. It has no fuel tank or recoverable force ammunition.

**AEX-05 — controlling clarification:** Hand-operated bench measuring/calibration box. An admitted workpiece must both fit the actual 4 × 4 × 2-inch jaw space and weigh no more than 2 lb. These are simultaneous limits, not alternatives. No general cargo space.
TI-ram.worksiteText:
KEEP actual complete primary kits and their original price/mass. A source-listed auxiliary already physically in that kit can fulfill that requirement, but ownership is not a duplicate item or an expensive recipe occurrence. The Runecarver working-optic completion is the narrow RC-09 kit binding. Enchanter's tools retain their stylus/ordinary focusing lens; Calligrapher supplies retain actual writing instruments; Tinker's tools need their actual precision drivers and calibration gauge. A selected output named Tool, Focus or Formula is not itself any of these complete kits.

NEW minimum physical worksite admission, not construction-cost additions: one active creator needs a stable clear working surface at least24×18in for carriers and appropriately sized actual jigs for the chosen complete weapon, suit or machine. Required Source Resonance Circle needs one clear5ft-square working bay and its actual ordinary focusing/stylus apparatus; this authorizes no magical energy source or new ritual. Slab must support the complete rune substrate; Scribe's Desk must allow actual open page preparation; Tinker's Workshop must safely support and fixture every currently worked assembly. For687, that means a clear60×30in sound work area supporting at least100lb of ram/work stock before crew loading. Record a real stronger station when actual load requires it. A portable sheet placed on a ledge does not become a stationary workshop.

No requirement makes all maximum-yield reserves occupy one overloaded bench simultaneously: use actual separate reserved storage and sequential work within the original hours. Hands, station capacity, light, safe access, preservative clocks and hazardous-material containment remain actual admission conditions. Ordinary table/station rental is not a catalyst supply, protected long-term vault or secret-work authorization.

All ordinary material defenses, object damage compatibility and carried-item targeting follow the actual equipment procedure. The whole-item B track is not duplicated onto each screw/page/limb. No unmodeled pin is an invented cheaper Sunder target. Repair quotations are material references, not physical replacement stock; record real supplies and their mass/disposition. Missing/burnt primary matter, irreversibly dismantled assemblies and already consumed debris fail reconstruction even if the full quotation is paid.
