cards.name: Mechanical Aptitude

sourceCard.name: Mechanical Aptitude
sourceCard.effect: Advantage on checks to understand, repair or disable mechanisms. Requires appropriate access and tools; no automatic control of enemy constructs.

source.originalText: Mechanical Aptitude: Gain advantage on checks to understand, repair, or disable mechanical devices.

cards.authoringDisposition: Accessible actual TI understanding/repair/disable checks; not automatic creation/service/salvage or every INT check. TD-06.

cards.name: Explosive Handling

sourceCard.name: Explosive Handling
sourceCard.effect: Throw a known prepared bomb as Bonus Action instead of Action. Removes ordinary accidental misfire, not Warmachine risk or enemy defenses. Cannot command a device with the same Bonus Action.

source.originalText: Explosive Handling: Throw bombs as a bonus action without risk of misfire.

cards.authoringDisposition: No recipe Trap or EN/Rune pulse qualifies. Same Bonus Action cannot command a companion.

cards.name: Quick Fingers

sourceCard.name: Quick Fingers
sourceCard.effect: Open unlocked latch, operate simple switch or retrieve a carried gadget. Does not activate damaging/healing devices, disarm a trap, reload every weapon or add another Bonus Action.

source.originalText: Quick Fingers: Perform device activation and manipulation actions with increased speed.

cards.authoringDisposition: An actual mundane latch/switch/retrieval can qualify; never damaging/healing activation, trap disarm, Rune arming or ram cycle.

cards.name: Technical Knowledge

sourceCard.name: Technical Knowledge
sourceCard.effect: INT+PB DC 15 identifies its ordinary purpose and operating control. Success reveals one safe use, not secret passwords or magical properties. Failure does not destroy item.

source.originalText: Technical Knowledge: Identify the properties and functions of mechanical or alchemical items on sight.

cards.authoringDisposition: Actual visible TI ordinary controls/purpose only; no magical properties, password, ownership or formula. TD-06.

cards.name: Improvised Engineering

sourceCard.name: Improvised Engineering
sourceCard.effect: Produce lockpick, wedge, pulley, clamp or equivalent ordinary implement. No weapons, explosives, currency, rare materials or autonomous effects; collapses afterward without sale value.

source.originalText: Improvised Engineering: Create temporary tools or simple devices from available materials.

cards.authoringDisposition: Actual compatible reusable auxiliary during its one-hour life; no permanent source input/body reserve or rare toolkit. TD-15.

cards.name: Deploy Anacite Drone

sourceCard.name: Deploy Anacite Drone
sourceCard.effect: Drone is automatic class engine. Selecting this card instead upgrades deployment to Bonus Action and permits 5 ft free initial placement. No free attacks, repair or extra drone.

source.originalText: Deploy Anacite Drone: Summon a mechanical companion that attacks with ranged bolts (1d6 damage + 25% chance to shock).

cards.authoringDisposition: Automatic class drone and selected deployment upgrade; no crafted companion is granted or receives this deployment upgrade.

cards.name: Tinker Bomb I

sourceCard.name: Tinker Bomb I
sourceCard.activation: Action or Bonus Action with Handling
sourceCard.rangeAndTarget: 10 ft radius within 30 ft, up to 3 creatures
sourceCard.effect: Bomb recipes are automatic engine. Selecting card increases throw range to 45 ft. Use exact bomb profile, saves, stock and friendly-fire rules; no free bomb creation during combat.

source.originalText: Tinker Bomb I: Create and throw Fire or Cold bombs that deal area effect damage.

cards.authoringDisposition: No recipe charge, element, range or rider inheritance.

cards.name: Field Repair

sourceCard.name: Field Repair
sourceCard.effect: Restore S d8+M HP, up to maximum, to functional damaged machine. Cannot revive destroyed objects, heal organic allies, reset duration or recharge limited uses. If the target is disabled by the Tinker’s protected Dissonance-routing feature, Field Repair also clears that disabled state. It does not reset duration, recharge, ammunition or per-rest uses.

source.originalText: Field Repair: Quickly fix a damaged mechanical device or construct.

cards.authoringDisposition: All43 actual positive-HP complete TI machines if damaged or specifically Dissonance-disabled; HP only, never servicing. TD-07/08.

cards.name: Analyze Weakness

sourceCard.name: Analyze Weakness
sourceCard.effect: Identify one visibly demonstrated damage resistance. Your next bomb/device damage against it ignores 2 flat DR, not resistance/immunity. No invented weakness or automatic secret knowledge.

source.originalText: Analyze Weakness: Study a target to identify vulnerabilities to specific damage types.

cards.authoringDisposition: The11 traps,18 automata and687 can benefit when the actual visible demonstrated resistance/source timing qualifies; ignores2 flat DR only, not resistance/immunity. No attack created.

cards.name: Jury-rig

sourceCard.effect: Choose+1 first attack roll/turn or+5 ft device movement. One modification per item, no stack. Does not change weapon category, spell function, summon limit or command budget.

source.originalText: Jury-rig: Temporarily modify a device or weapon to perform a different function.

cards.authoringDisposition: Actual EN weapon through printed weapon predicate; actual TI attack or existing Speed through TD-09; no new attack/Speed.

source.originalText: Enhanced Drone Control: Your Anacite Drone gains improved targeting and responsiveness.

cards.authoringDisposition: Class drone accuracy/range only;686 and ordinary crafted automata receive none.

paragraphs.label: Effect and operation
paragraphs.text: Each finished body has enhancement +1, maximum 1 charge(s), and cold as its sole charge damage type. An admitted actual weapon adds +1 to its eligible item accuracy comparison and +1 ordinary flat weapon damage once per hit; its unsuppressed ordinary B/P/S damage is magical. Charged Strike costs one Action and one charge before its single actual weapon attack; a hit adds 1d6 cold to that attack's damage event. It is not the Attack Action and grants no Extra Attack; an ordinary critical doubles dice, never flat bonuses. An admitted armor suit supplies +1 in equipment.defense-enhancement only while its worn armor formula is selected. Typed Guard spends a Reaction and charge on a positive resolved cold damage component, after defenses but before HP/positive-damage triggers, reducing it by 1d6 to a minimum of zero. Every other admitted carrier uses Typed Pulse: Action, one charge, one manipulating hand, one perceived creature or physically compatible object within 30 feet and line of effect; fixed +5 nonspell attack, hit 2d6 cold, no ability/PB/flat enhancement added again. Only the profile belonging to the registered body is available. These activations spend no RP, do not enter spell cadence and cannot be Counterspelled. Charges refill to maximum only at an eligible actual campaign 06:00 dawn under EN-06; suppressed/missing/zero-HP items miss that event, with no catch-up or local-sunrise/transfer reset. Titles supply no unprinted flight, command, healing or class focus. EN-01–10 and AC-07 supply the full use and comparison procedures.

paragraphs.label: Complete output bodies
paragraphs.text: Choose before any work: EN-armor: Existing Standard Medium chain shirt default; other registered ordinary armor suits retain their exact source body. 50 gp, 20 lb, ordinary B15, structural AC 19, dimensions 30 × 22 × 6 inches. See the complete body catalogue for original primaries, constituent masses, hands, capacity and support. A creature output replaces stock object HP/AC with its printed creature statistics. EN alternate weapon/suit hosts use their exact registered existing equipment profile; these default figures do not overwrite that alternate body.

paragraphs.label: Before creation
paragraphs.text: Reserve 6 actual complete never-magically-altered bodies, one model/size per order, in an exclusive fixed order. All must be complete and positive-HP immediately before the completion roll, even if fewer outputs will result. Bodies are additional to the exact source batch components and working tools. Pre-roll lawful replacement keeps its ordered position; no post-roll acquisition, substitution or reordering. Transform the first resolved outputs; unused bodies remain actual mundane stock. Record material identity, condition, real storage, actual station capacity, preservation and safe handling; a quoted price supplies none of those facts.

paragraphs.label: Creation check and work
paragraphs.text: Enchanting level 4; INT with actual Enchanter's tools training, one PB or replacing expertise, DC 8. Untrained otherwise eligible level 1–4 uses no tool PB and disadvantage; trained recipe eligibility is max(4, trade level), with actual formula access. Source duration 4 hours; operational 240 active minutes, or 180 for an eligible Forge Dwarf. The included first stable phase is 15 minutes (15 for that Dwarf); remaining work is 225/165 minutes respectively, in declared phases of at most 480 minutes. Only actual incorporated inputs stabilize; raw/returned catalyst clocks continue. Interruption loses unfinished-phase progress, not costs or completed work.

paragraphs.label: Facility and assistance
paragraphs.text: Actual Resonance Circle, with Enchanter's tools, Focusing lens, Inscription stylus; fieldCraftable=false, source timeMode=expedition. A field label never overrides the false creation flag. Fixed compatible facilities, actual minimum surface/bay/fixtures, safe access and expedition-site permissions remain required. Maximum 0 eligible assistants work all required hours without shortening the task or gaining assistant XP. Ordinary facilities/tools grant +0. Two active work Watches, no overlapping labor/rest credit, actual hired capacity and lawful access still apply.

paragraphs.label: Formula and advancement
paragraphs.text: Preserve the exact discovery and progression records: {"discovery": {"sources": ["trainer", "starter manual", "common experimentation"], "minimumResearchHours": 0, "requiresFormula": false, "formulaConsumed": false}, "skillProgression": {"skillXPOnSuccess": 4, "trivialAtSkillLevel": 9, "firstCraftBonus": true}}. The crafting framework determines actual first/repeat/qualified-failure/triviality XP. Source skillXPOnSuccess is not an extra award on use, repair, study, service or temporary class fabrication. A finished item supplies no formula/proficiency.

paragraphs.label: Manufacturing outcomes
paragraphs.text: Mishap 0; Failed 0; Flawed 2; Standard 4; Exceptional yield 5; Masterwork yield 6. Natural 1 is Mishap; natural 20 adds no band shift. An eligible Forge Dwarf's Standard becomes Exceptional. Alternatively retain 4 structural objects with the strongest P25/P50 workmanship once. Maximum = B + max(1, floor(B×P/100)) for positive P, else B; one existing/new singleton persistent flaw halves last, minimum 1. Preserve old maximum minus current damage deficit, clamping the new current to [0,newMax]. Q1 Flawed creates one persistent flaw; Q≥2 reduced yield adds no new singleton flaw, even when one output remains. Standard never heals. Actual EN host size/grade B takes precedence over default-body examples. No outcome improves charges, potency, source DC, spell rank, capacities or permissions; later repair does not remove a flaw or reapply manufacturing quality.

paragraphs.text: Each finished body has enhancement +1, maximum 2 charge(s), and bludgeoning as its sole charge damage type. An admitted actual weapon adds +1 to its eligible item accuracy comparison and +1 ordinary flat weapon damage once per hit; its unsuppressed ordinary B/P/S damage is magical. Charged Strike costs one Action and one charge before its single actual weapon attack; a hit adds 1d6 bludgeoning to that attack's damage event. It is not the Attack Action and grants no Extra Attack; an ordinary critical doubles dice, never flat bonuses. An admitted armor suit supplies +1 in equipment.defense-enhancement only while its worn armor formula is selected. Typed Guard spends a Reaction and charge on a positive resolved bludgeoning damage component, after defenses but before HP/positive-damage triggers, reducing it by 1d6 to a minimum of zero. Every other admitted carrier uses Typed Pulse: Action, one charge, one manipulating hand, one perceived creature or physically compatible object within 30 feet and line of effect; fixed +5 nonspell attack, hit 2d6 bludgeoning, no ability/PB/flat enhancement added again. paragraphs.label: Effect and operation
paragraphs.text: Each finished body has enhancement +2, maximum 3 charge(s), and fire as its sole charge damage type. An admitted actual weapon adds +2 to its eligible item accuracy comparison and +2 ordinary flat weapon damage once per hit; its unsuppressed ordinary B/P/S damage is magical. Charged Strike costs one Action and one charge before its single actual weapon attack; a hit adds 2d6 fire to that attack's damage event. It is not the Attack Action and grants no Extra Attack; an ordinary critical doubles dice, never flat bonuses. An admitted armor suit supplies +2 in equipment.defense-enhancement only while its worn armor formula is selected. Typed Guard spends a Reaction and charge on a positive resolved fire damage component, after defenses but before HP/positive-damage triggers, reducing it by 2d6 to a minimum of zero. Every other admitted carrier uses Typed Pulse: Action, one charge, one manipulating hand, one perceived creature or physically compatible object within 30 feet and line of effect; fixed +6 nonspell attack, hit 4d6 fire, no ability/PB/flat enhancement added again. ## Mythic Frost Wand of Silver Dragonheart — recipe-151

**Reviewed internal playtest; director-only; authored-operational exact approval complete.**

Use the [complete operating guide](ADVANCED_CRAFT_INTERNAL_OPERATIONAL_GUIDE.md) and [body catalogue](ADVANCED_CRAFT_INTERNAL_BODY_CATALOGUE.md).

**Effect and operation**

Each finished body has enhancement +2, maximum 4 charge(s), and cold as its sole charge damage type. An admitted actual weapon adds +2 to its eligible item accuracy comparison and +2 ordinary flat weapon damage once per hit; its unsuppressed ordinary B/P/S damage is magical. Charged Strike costs one Action and one charge before its single actual weapon attack; a hit adds 2d6 cold to that attack's damage event. It is not the Attack Action and grants no Extra Attack; an ordinary critical doubles dice, never flat bonuses. An admitted armor suit supplies +2 in equipment.defense-enhancement only while its worn armor formula is selected. Typed Guard spends a Reaction and charge on a positive resolved cold damage component, after defenses but before HP/positive-damage triggers, reducing it by 2d6 to a minimum of zero. Every other admitted carrier uses Typed Pulse: Action, one charge, one manipulating hand, one perceived creature or physically compatible object within 30 feet and line of effect; fixed +6 nonspell attack, hit 4d6 cold, no ability/PB/flat enhancement added again. Only the profile belonging to the registered body is available. These activations spend no RP, do not enter spell cadence and cannot be Counterspelled. Charges refill to maximum only at an eligible actual campaign 06:00 dawn under EN-06; suppressed/missing/zero-HP items miss that event, with no catch-up or local-sunrise/transfer reset. Titles supply no unprinted flight, command, healing or class focus. EN-01–10 and AC-07 supply the full use and comparison procedures.

**Complete output bodies**

Choose before any work: EN-wand: Handheld hardwood conductor, no ordinary weapon or spell-focus grant. 1 gp, 1 lb, ordinary B5, structural AC 15, dimensions 12 × 1 × 1 inches. See the complete body catalogue for original primaries, constituent masses, hands, capacity and support. A creature output replaces stock object HP/AC with its printed creature statistics. EN alternate weapon/suit hosts use their exact registered existing equipment profile; these default figures do not overwrite that alternate body.

**Before creation**

Reserve 1 actual complete never-magically-altered bodies, one model/size per order, in an exclusive fixed order. All must be complete and positive-HP immediately before the completion roll, even if fewer outputs will result. Bodies are additional to the exact source batch components and working tools. Pre-roll lawful replacement keeps its ordered position; no post-roll acquisition, substitution or reordering. Transform the first resolved outputs; unused bodies remain actual mundane stock. **Creation check and work**

Enchanting level 16; INT with actual Enchanter's tools training, one PB or replacing expertise, DC 20. Untrained otherwise eligible level 1–4 uses no tool PB and disadvantage; trained recipe eligibility is max(4, trade level), with actual formula access. Source duration 1 month; operational 9600 active minutes, or 7200 for an eligible Forge Dwarf. The included first stable phase is 15 minutes (15 for that Dwarf); remaining work is 9585/7185 minutes respectively, in declared phases of at most 480 minutes. Only actual incorporated inputs stabilize; raw/returned catalyst clocks continue. Interruption loses unfinished-phase progress, not costs or completed work.

Actual Resonance Circle, with Enchanter's tools, Focusing lens, Inscription stylus; fieldCraftable=false, source timeMode=haven. A field label never overrides the false creation flag. Maximum 2 eligible assistants work all required hours without shortening the task or gaining assistant XP. Ordinary facilities/tools grant +0. Two active work Watches, no overlapping labor/rest credit, actual hired capacity and lawful access still apply.

paragraphs.label: Effect and operation
paragraphs.text: Each finished body has enhancement +2, maximum 4 charge(s), and thunder as its sole charge damage type. An admitted actual weapon adds +2 to its eligible item accuracy comparison and +2 ordinary flat weapon damage once per hit; its unsuppressed ordinary B/P/S damage is magical. Charged Strike costs one Action and one charge before its single actual weapon attack; a hit adds 2d6 thunder to that attack's damage event. It is not the Attack Action and grants no Extra Attack; an ordinary critical doubles dice, never flat bonuses. An admitted armor suit supplies +2 in equipment.defense-enhancement only while its worn armor formula is selected. Typed Guard spends a Reaction and charge on a positive resolved thunder damage component, after defenses but before HP/positive-damage triggers, reducing it by 2d6 to a minimum of zero. Every other admitted carrier uses Typed Pulse: Action, one charge, one manipulating hand, one perceived creature or physically compatible object within 30 feet and line of effect; fixed +6 nonspell attack, hit 4d6 thunder, no ability/PB/flat enhancement added again. Only the profile belonging to the registered body is available. These activations spend no RP, do not enter spell cadence and cannot be Counterspelled. Charges refill to maximum only at an eligible actual campaign 06:00 dawn under EN-06; suppressed/missing/zero-HP items miss that event, with no catch-up or local-sunrise/transfer reset. Use the [complete operating guide](ADVANCED_CRAFT_INTERNAL_OPERATIONAL_GUIDE.md) and [body catalogue](ADVANCED_CRAFT_INTERNAL_BODY_CATALOGUE.md).

**Effect and operation**

A prepared plate has 1 lifetime charge(s). First legal creature entry spends one: DC 8 STR save; failure is Restrained for at most 60 seconds. Repeat the save at the end of each regular turn. An Action permits STR (Athletics) or DEX (Acrobatics) escape, or an adjacent helper's STR (Athletics), at that same DC through Core task binary resolution. Moving the target completely outside the original trigger square/volume, or moving, covering, suppressing or Breaking the original plate, ends this particular Binding restraint. Restoring the plate does not resume that ended restraint, refund its charge or rearm its ground trigger. Other independent restraints remain separately governed. Use RC-01–04 entry, placement, next-regular-start/six-second arming delay, cap, discharge and manual rearming rules. No Stun, occupancy retrigger, ally exemption, recharge or repair refill.

**Rune control and examination**

A ground plate that is moved, rotated off its declared working face, wholly covered, Broken, incomplete or suppressed cannot trigger. Restore an invalidated ground trigger only through the actual one-Action manual arming procedure on its cleared eligible square, followed by the existing next-regular-start or six-second delay; merely uncovering, repairing or unsuppressing does not rearm it. A capable authorized setter can disarm their accessible plate with an Action; physically removing it uses its actual item interaction afterward. These ground-trigger rules do not replace the specific direct-touch Healing procedure or the separate attuned-Ward duration procedure.

With safe access within five feet, one active minute permits an INT (Arcana) or INT check using Runecarver's tools against the original recipe creation DC, using normal Core task shifts collapsed to success/failure. Apply only the actual applicable proficiency contribution. This examination reveals supported operating type/trigger, not donor lore, and failure grants no repeat on unchanged evidence. Disarming an unknown accessible Rune requires actual Runecarver's-tools proficiency and tools, one active minute, and that source DC. Failure leaves it armed; it discharges only if an actual eligible entry/touch event occurs, not merely because the check failed. An unrelated tool proficiency is not a substitute.

**Complete output bodies**

Choose before any work: RC-plate: One steel inscription plate, captive feet and strap; standalone item even when attached to another body. 2 gp, 1 lb, ordinary B5, structural AC 19, dimensions 4 × 4 × 0.5 inches. EN alternate weapon/suit hosts use their exact registered existing equipment profile; these default figures do not overwrite that alternate body.

**Before creation**

Reserve 3 actual complete never-magically-altered bodies, one model/size per order, in an exclusive fixed order. Pre-roll lawful replacement keeps its ordered position; no post-roll acquisition, substitution or reordering. Transform the first resolved outputs; unused bodies remain actual mundane stock. Record material identity, condition, real storage, actual station capacity, preservation and safe handling; a quoted price supplies none of those facts.

Rune Carving level 4; INT with actual Runecarver's tools training, one PB or replacing expertise, DC 8. **Effect and operation**

A prepared plate has 2 lifetime charge(s). First legal creature entry spends one: DC 17 STR save; failure is Restrained for at most 60 seconds. Repeat the save at the end of each regular turn. An Action permits STR (Athletics) or DEX (Acrobatics) escape, or an adjacent helper's STR (Athletics), at that same DC through Core task binary resolution. Moving the target completely outside the original trigger square/volume, or moving, covering, suppressing or Breaking the original plate, ends this particular Binding restraint. Restoring the plate does not resume that ended restraint, refund its charge or rearm its ground trigger. Other independent restraints remain separately governed. Use RC-01–04 entry, placement, next-regular-start/six-second arming delay, cap, discharge and manual rearming rules. No Stun, occupancy retrigger, ally exemption, recharge or repair refill.

**Rune control and examination**

A ground plate that is moved, rotated off its declared working face, wholly covered, Broken, incomplete or suppressed cannot trigger. Restore an invalidated ground trigger only through the actual one-Action manual arming procedure on its cleared eligible square, followed by the existing next-regular-start or six-second delay; merely uncovering, repairing or unsuppressing does not rearm it. A capable authorized setter can disarm their accessible plate with an Action; physically removing it uses its actual item interaction afterward. These ground-trigger rules do not replace the specific direct-touch Healing procedure or the separate attuned-Ward duration procedure.

With safe access within five feet, one active minute permits an INT (Arcana) or INT check using Runecarver's tools against the original recipe creation DC, using normal Core task shifts collapsed to success/failure. Apply only the actual applicable proficiency contribution. This examination reveals supported operating type/trigger, not donor lore, and failure grants no repeat on unchanged evidence. Disarming an unknown accessible Rune requires actual Runecarver's-tools proficiency and tools, one active minute, and that source DC. Failure leaves it armed; it discharges only if an actual eligible entry/touch event occurs, not merely because the check failed. An unrelated tool proficiency is not a substitute.

paragraphs.label: Effect and operation
paragraphs.text: A prepared plate has 5 lifetime charge(s). First legal creature entry spends one burst centered on that actual plate, radius 10 feet, all creatures with line of effect including allies/setter: DC 23 DEX, 10d6 acid on failure and zero on success. No object damage, extra condition or second burst for simultaneous entrants. Use RC-01–03 and RC-05 placement, delay, one-item-per-round discharge, stable event order, disarming and cleared-square manual rearm. Remaining in the square does not retrigger. Neither dawn nor restoration refills it.

paragraphs.label: Rune control and examination
paragraphs.text:
A ground plate that is moved, rotated off its declared working face, wholly covered, Broken, incomplete or suppressed cannot trigger. Restore an invalidated ground trigger only through the actual one-Action manual arming procedure on its cleared eligible square, followed by the existing next-regular-start or six-second delay; merely uncovering, repairing or unsuppressing does not rearm it. A capable authorized setter can disarm their accessible plate with an Action; physically removing it uses its actual item interaction afterward. These ground-trigger rules do not replace the specific direct-touch Healing procedure or the separate attuned-Ward duration procedure.

With safe access within five feet, one active minute permits an INT (Arcana) or INT check using Runecarver's tools against the original recipe creation DC, using normal Core task shifts collapsed to success/failure. Apply only the actual applicable proficiency contribution. This examination reveals supported operating type/trigger, not donor lore, and failure grants no repeat on unchanged evidence. Disarming an unknown accessible Rune requires actual Runecarver's-tools proficiency and tools, one active minute, and that source DC. Failure leaves it armed; it discharges only if an actual eligible entry/touch event occurs, not merely because the check failed. An unrelated tool proficiency is not a substitute.

paragraphs.label: Complete output bodies
paragraphs.text: Choose before any work: RC-plate: One steel inscription plate, captive feet and strap; standalone item even when attached to another body. 2 gp, 1 lb, ordinary B5, structural AC 19, dimensions 4 × 4 × 0.5 inches. See the complete body catalogue for original primaries, constituent masses, hands, capacity and support. A creature output replaces stock object HP/AC with its printed creature statistics. EN alternate weapon/suit hosts use their exact registered existing equipment profile; these default figures do not overwrite that alternate body.

paragraphs.label: Before creation
paragraphs.text: Reserve 1 actual complete never-magically-altered bodies, one model/size per order, in an exclusive fixed order. All must be complete and positive-HP immediately before the completion roll, even if fewer outputs will result. Bodies are additional to the exact source batch components and working tools. Pre-roll lawful replacement keeps its ordered position; no post-roll acquisition, substitution or reordering. Transform the first resolved outputs; unused bodies remain actual mundane stock. Record material identity, condition, real storage, actual station capacity, preservation and safe handling; a quoted price supplies none of those facts.

paragraphs.label: Creation check and work
paragraphs.text: Rune Carving level 20; INT with actual Runecarver's tools training, one PB or replacing expertise, DC 23. Untrained otherwise eligible level 1–4 uses no tool PB and disadvantage; trained recipe eligibility is max(4, trade level), with actual formula access. Source duration 3 months; operational 28800 active minutes, or 21600 for an eligible Forge Dwarf. The included first stable phase is 15 minutes (15 for that Dwarf); remaining work is 28785/21585 minutes respectively, in declared phases of at most 480 minutes. Only actual incorporated inputs stabilize; raw/returned catalyst clocks continue. Interruption loses unfinished-phase progress, not costs or completed work.

paragraphs.label: Facility and assistance
paragraphs.text: Actual Runecarver's Slab, with Runecarver's tools, Carving stylus, Focusing crystal; fieldCraftable=false, source timeMode=legacy. A field label never overrides the false creation flag. Fixed compatible facilities, actual minimum surface/bay/fixtures, safe access and expedition-site permissions remain required. Maximum 3 eligible assistants work all required hours without shortening the task or gaining assistant XP. Ordinary facilities/tools grant +0. Two active work Watches, no overlapping labor/rest credit, actual hired capacity and lawful access still apply.

paragraphs.label: Effect and operation
paragraphs.text: This actual physical tool/device/sensor has +1 appropriate checks and 2 utility charge(s). Before the roll, the actual lead selects this item, directly performs genuinely necessary compatible work for one active minute or throughout a separately allowed shorter task, and spends one charge. Compare it once in equipment.leather-task-enhancement; a stronger eligible source does not refund the spent charge. The original required ordinary tools still apply. Its physical probe/gauge/jaws must actually reach and perform the work; it does not detect hidden creatures through walls. No assistance to creation, repair, re-encoding, recharge or servicing of any bonus-granting advanced/gathering item, including itself or another utility. Actual ordinary engineering, exposed-mechanism investigation, compatible tool tasks and genuine formula research can qualify. Complete positive-HP unsuppressed participating state is required at work and resolution. TI-06 provides actual one-hour trained servicing to reset printed maximum; HP repair, rest and ownership do not.

paragraphs.label: Routed Dissonance
paragraphs.text: Only the acquired TD-08 feature, once per genuine short rest, permits a Bonus Action to route up to two current Dissonance into one own active qualifying device within 30 feet. The routed disabled state prevents movement, attacks, auras, triggers and every other active device use. A routed trap cannot discharge, and a routed utility cannot provide its charged task benefit while disabled. Existing durations and paid service/winding clocks continue. Clearing the disable requires its existing specifically authorized completed removal procedure; it does not refill charges, service, RP or Refrain, erase expenditures, or grant a queued activation. An invalid blocked declaration spends nothing; a later disable does not refund a previously legal committed cost. Actual Field Repair, the existing ten-active-minute/1RP/Tinker's-tools procedure, the origin Tinker's next completed genuine short rest or completed qualifying ordinary repair may clear only the permitted functional state. A buyer's unrelated rest does not clear it.

**Reviewed internal playtest; director-only; authored-operational exact approval complete.**

Use the [complete operating guide](ADVANCED_CRAFT_INTERNAL_OPERATIONAL_GUIDE.md) and [body catalogue](ADVANCED_CRAFT_INTERNAL_BODY_CATALOGUE.md).

**Effect and operation**

This fixed trap has 3 charge(s). Spend one minute with both hands and actual Tinker's tools to place it on a stable eligible unoccupied 5-foot square, then an Action to arm; it becomes armed at the next regular-turn start or six-second boundary. Its first actual creature entrant, including allies, consumes one charge and the setter's available shared offensive allowance: DC 19 DEX, 4d8 force on failure, zero on success. It then disarms. No discharge, charge spend or queued attack when the setter's allowance is unavailable. Forced movement/fall/teleport arrival can be entry; remaining in place is not. Moving it disarms it. Max three armed crafted traps per setter; manual reset, cleared square, delay and one-item-per-round guard remain. Setter incapacity/death alone does not switch off an eligible automatic trap. A capable authorized setter can safely disarm their accessible trap with one Action. This is distinct from the unfamiliar-trap procedure: trained thieves' tools or Tinker's tools, the appropriate DEX/INT method, one active minute and the printed trap save DC. Neither route grants free movement, rearming, servicing or replenishment. TI-02 gives the remaining full disarm rules. TI-06's trained one-hour servicing may refill charges; HP repair/rest may not.

Only the acquired TD-08 feature, once per genuine short rest, permits a Bonus Action to route up to two current Dissonance into one own active qualifying device within 30 feet. Clearing the disable requires its existing specifically authorized completed removal procedure; it does not refill charges, service, RP or Refrain, erase expenditures, or grant a queued activation. An invalid blocked declaration spends nothing; a later disable does not refund a previously legal committed cost. Actual Field Repair, the existing ten-active-minute/1RP/Tinker's-tools procedure, the origin Tinker's next completed genuine short rest or completed qualifying ordinary repair may clear only the permitted functional state. **Reviewed internal playtest; restricted; authored-operational exact approval complete.**

Use the [complete operating guide](ADVANCED_CRAFT_INTERNAL_OPERATIONAL_GUIDE.md) and [body catalogue](ADVANCED_CRAFT_INTERNAL_BODY_CATALOGUE.md).

**Effect and operation**

Choose Tiny or Small before work and keep that size. The finished Construct has AC 14 and maximum 42 HP; full unmodified B5 chassis gives full HP, otherwise initial HP is max(1, floor(42 × latest chassis HP / 5)). Ordinary senses/passive 10; no flight, PB, equipment slots or Anacite modules. Poison damage and Poisoned immunity only; other defenses are not inferred. Maximum service units 3: First actual operation of this automaton in a genuine encounter spends one service unit and opens that encounter's paid operating block, lasting at most ten elapsed minutes from that operation. Mere encounter start does not debit a stored or otherwise unoperated automaton. Ordinary idleness before a block starts spends nothing and grants no active behavior. Continuing operation beyond a block's expiry needs another paid block; a distinct genuine encounter has its own service requirement. Preserve TI-05's transition from an operating noncombat block into a genuine encounter, its no-refund/no-clock-pause rules and its physical-identity history. Outside encounters, first actual operation spends one service unit for one ten-elapsed-minute noncombat block. Continuing past expiry needs another; entering combat closes the noncombat block and spends a new unit. Zero units inside an already paid block permits that block only. Suppression/shutdown keeps the clock running. TI-04 binds a capable consenting INT-6+ controller with ten minutes of real tools/permission, max three active ordinary crafted automata separately from one 686. One owner-wide Bonus Action command and one relevant offensive allowance per numbered round across class/crafted devices; actual communication within 60 feet, execution after the whole controller turn, no independent Reaction. The commanded creature moves and makes one attack or permitted task; powered uncommanded behavior is only defensive movement/Dodge. Transfer cannot give a second attack. Finite noncombat programming is ten minutes, with Action start and paid blocks; no professional crafting, script use or ram crew. Only the acquired TD-08 feature, once per genuine short rest, permits a Bonus Action to route up to two current Dissonance into one own active qualifying device within 30 feet. **Reviewed internal playtest; director-only; authored-operational exact approval complete.**

Use the [complete operating guide](ADVANCED_CRAFT_INTERNAL_OPERATIONAL_GUIDE.md) and [body catalogue](ADVANCED_CRAFT_INTERNAL_BODY_CATALOGUE.md).

**Effect and operation**

Choose Tiny or Small before work and keep that size. The finished Construct has AC 14 and maximum 46 HP; full unmodified B5 chassis gives full HP, otherwise initial HP is max(1, floor(46 × latest chassis HP / 5)). Its fixed magical nonspell melee attack is +5 to hit, reach 5 feet, 3d6 radiant on hit, no ability damage or condition rider. Ordinary attack natural results apply. Tiny: STR 6, DEX 12, CON 10, INT 3, WIS 10, CHA 1, walk 20 feet, gripper load at most 5 lb. Small: STR 12, DEX 10, CON 12, INT 3, WIS 10, CHA 1, walk 25 feet, at most 20 lb. Ordinary senses/passive 10; no flight, PB, equipment slots or Anacite modules. Poison damage and Poisoned immunity only; other defenses are not inferred. Maximum service units 3: First actual operation of this automaton in a genuine encounter spends one service unit and opens that encounter's paid operating block, lasting at most ten elapsed minutes from that operation. Mere encounter start does not debit a stored or otherwise unoperated automaton. Ordinary idleness before a block starts spends nothing and grants no active behavior. Continuing operation beyond a block's expiry needs another paid block; a distinct genuine encounter has its own service requirement. Preserve TI-05's transition from an operating noncombat block into a genuine encounter, its no-refund/no-clock-pause rules and its physical-identity history. Outside encounters, first actual operation spends one service unit for one ten-elapsed-minute noncombat block. Continuing past expiry needs another; entering combat closes the noncombat block and spends a new unit. Zero units inside an already paid block permits that block only. Suppression/shutdown keeps the clock running. TI-04 binds a capable consenting INT-6+ controller with ten minutes of real tools/permission, max three active ordinary crafted automata separately from one 686. One owner-wide Bonus Action command and one relevant offensive allowance per numbered round across class/crafted devices; actual communication within 60 feet, execution after the whole controller turn, no independent Reaction. The commanded creature moves and makes one attack or permitted task; powered uncommanded behavior is only defensive movement/Dodge. Transfer cannot give a second attack. Finite noncombat programming is ten minutes, with Action start and paid blocks; no professional crafting, script use or ram crew. At zero HP it is a destroyed recoverable wreck if original primaries survive; no death saves, Wounds or ordinary biological healing. TI-06 servicing and AC-09/TD-07 restoration are distinct. Structural quality never changes the printed creature statistics. TI-03–07 govern the complete procedure.

**Routed Dissonance**

Only the acquired TD-08 feature, once per genuine short rest, permits a Bonus Action to route up to two current Dissonance into one own active qualifying device within 30 feet. The routed disabled state prevents movement, attacks, auras, triggers and every other active device use. A routed trap cannot discharge, and a routed utility cannot provide its charged task benefit while disabled. Existing durations and paid service/winding clocks continue. Clearing the disable requires its existing specifically authorized completed removal procedure; it does not refill charges, service, RP or Refrain, erase expenditures, or grant a queued activation. An invalid blocked declaration spends nothing; a later disable does not refund a previously legal committed cost. A buyer's unrelated rest does not clear it.

paragraphs.label: Complete custom procedure — RC-10
